How to Use This Book Is book se sabse zyada fayda kaise uthayein

Ye grammar ki book nahi hai. Yahan koi rule ratna nahi hai. Har din ek real situation hai: introduction, shopping, doctor, phone call, interview. Aap wahi lines seekhoge jo log sach mein bolte hain, aur class mein unhe bol-bol kar pakka karoge. 30 din baad aap English ki 60 se 80% baatein samajh paoge aur bina dare jawab de paoge.

Warm-upClass shuru hone se pehle 30 second sochiye.

Today's LectureAaj ka topic, easy Hinglish mein, teacher ke saath.

Power PhrasesSpeaker dabakar suniye, mic dabakar boliye, book batayegi kitna sahi bola.

Real ConversationPoori baatcheet suniye, phir partner ke saath act kariye.

Picture TalkPicture dekhkar sawaalon ke jawab zor se boliye.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi se direct translate karne pe hone wali galtiyan.

Flash CardsHinglish padhiye, English boliye, phir card palat kar check kariye.

Quick QuizIs situation mein aap kya bologe? Sahi jawab chuniye.

Sentence BuilderWords pe tap karke poora sentence banaiye.

Role-Play2 minute ka timer, partner ke saath, bina book dekhe.

1-Minute Challenge1 minute bina ruke boliye, apni awaaz record karke suniye.

Homework + DoneGhar ka kaam kariye aur "Mark complete" dabaiye. Roadmap pe tick lag jayega.

Jamia Wallah ke 5 Golden Rules

  1. Galti = seekhna. Galat bolna, chup rehne se 100 guna better hai.
  2. Zor se boliye. Mann mein padhne se English nahi aati. Har line awaaz mein boliye.
  3. Roz 20 minute. Class ke baad ghar pe 20 minute: suniye, repeat kariye, record kariye.
  4. Translate mat kariye, copy kariye. Poori line ko ek "block" ki tarah yaad kariye.
  5. English Hour. Roz ek ghanta ghar pe ya doston ke saath sirf English mein baat.

01

Day 01  ·  Week 1  ·  Me & My World

Introduce Yourself Like a Pro

Apna introduction dena, pehli mulaqat mein hi solid impression

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap kisi bhi naye insaan ke saamne 1 minute tak apna introduction English mein de paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Sochiye: agar aaj class mein koi pooche "Tell me something about yourself", toh aap pehli 3 lines kya bologe? Mann mein nahi, dheere se bolkar dekhiye.

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Introduction ka 5-step formula

Greeting → Name → Place → Study/Work → Hobby/Goal. Bas yahi order yaad rakhiye: "Hello, I'm Sana. I'm from Okhla. I'm doing B.A. I love cooking. I want to become a teacher." Paanch chhoti lines, aur aapka intro ready.

Chhote sentences = zyada confidence

Lambi line banane ke chakkar mein log atak jaate hain. Ek line mein ek hi baat boliye. Native speakers bhi intro mein chhoti lines hi bolte hain.

Intro ke baad sawaal wapas poochiye

Apni baat khatam karke poochiye "And you?" ya "What about you?". Isse baat aage badhti hai aur saamne wala bhi comfortable feel karta hai.

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

Hi, I'm Ayaan. Nice to meet you.

Hi, main Ayaan hoon. Aapse milkar accha laga.

2

I'm from Batla House, Delhi.

Main Batla House, Delhi se hoon.

3

I'm a student. I'm doing B.Com.

Main student hoon. B.Com kar raha/rahi hoon.

4

I work at a mobile shop.

Main ek mobile shop pe kaam karta/karti hoon.

5

In my free time, I like playing cricket.

Free time mein mujhe cricket khelna pasand hai.

6

I joined this course to speak English confidently.

Maine ye course confidently English bolne ke liye join kiya hai.

7

What about you?

Aur aap?

8

It was nice talking to you.

Aapse baat karke accha laga.

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

First day at Jamia WallahJamia Wallah mein pehla din
Ayaan

Hi! I'm Ayaan. Is this the English class?

Hi! Main Ayaan hoon. Kya ye English ki class hai?

Zoya

Yes, it is. Hi Ayaan, I'm Zoya. Nice to meet you.

Haan. Hi Ayaan, main Zoya hoon. Milkar accha laga.

Ayaan

Nice to meet you too. Where are you from?

Mujhe bhi. Aap kahaan se ho?

Zoya

I'm from Zakir Nagar. And you?

Main Zakir Nagar se hoon. Aur aap?

Ayaan

I live in Batla House, just five minutes from here.

Main Batla House mein rehta hoon, yahan se bas paanch minute.

Zoya

That's close! What do you do?

Kaafi paas hai! Aap kya karte ho?

Ayaan

I'm doing B.Com from DU. What about you?

Main DU se B.Com kar raha hoon. Aur aap?

Zoya

I'm preparing for an airline job, so I need good English.

Main airline job ki taiyari kar rahi hoon, isliye achhi English chahiye.

Ayaan

Great! I want to speak confidently in interviews.

Badhiya! Main interviews mein confidently bolna chahta hoon.

Zoya

Then let's practise together every day.

Toh chalo roz saath mein practice karte hain.

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

Picture TalkPicture dekhiye aur boliye

  1. Where are these two people?
  2. What do you think they are saying?
  3. Introduce yourself to the person in the picture.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ Myself Ayaan.

✓ I'm Ayaan. / My name is Ayaan.

"Myself Ayaan" Hindi jaisa lagta hai, bahar koi aise nahi bolta. Hamesha "I'm ..." se start kariye.

✗ I am belonging to Delhi.

✓ I'm from Delhi.

Intro mein "belonging to" nahi bolte. Seedha aur simple: "I'm from ..."

✗ My good name is Zoya.

✓ My name is Zoya.

"Good name" Hindi ke "shubh naam" se aaya hai. English mein bas "name".

Flash CardsHinglish padhiye, English mein boliye, phir card palatiye

Role-Play CardsDo-do ke pair mein, bina book dekhe

New neighbour

Partner AAap naye-naye mohalle mein aaye ho. Apne padosi ko apna intro do aur unke baare mein poocho.
Partner BAap purane padosi ho. Welcome karo, apna naam aur kaam batao, aur 2 sawaal poocho.

Partner BAap student ho. 5-step formula se jawab do aur end mein "Thank you, sir/ma'am" bolo.

1-Minute Speaking ChallengeRukna nahi hai, bas bolte rehna hai

Stand up and introduce yourself for one full minute: greeting, name, place, study or work, family, hobby, and why you joined this course. Finish with "Thank you".

Homework

Confidence Tip

Pehli line sabse important hai. "Hi, I'm ___. Nice to meet you." itne confidence se boliye ki aage ki baat khud nikal aaye. Smile kariye, aankhon mein dekhiye.

02

Day 02  ·  Week 1  ·  Me & My World

Greetings & Small Talk

Haal-chaal poochna aur chhoti-moti baatein

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap kisi se bhi haal-chaal poochkar 2-3 minute ki halki-phulki baat start aur end kar paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Jab aap kisi purane dost se achanak milte ho toh Hindi mein kya bolte ho? "Arre! Kaise ho? Kitne din baad!" Aaj yahi sab English mein.

Today's LectureAaj ki class

"How are you?" ka jawab sirf "I'm fine" nahi

Sab log "I am fine, thank you" rat lete hain. Real life mein log bolte hain: "I'm good, thanks!", "Not bad!", "Pretty busy these days." Aur phir zaroor poochte hain "How about you?"

Small talk ke safe topics

Weather, traffic, khaana, padhai, cricket, festivals. Pehli mulaqat mein salary, shaadi, religion aur politics se bachiye.

Baat khatam karna bhi ek skill hai

Achanak chale jaana rude lagta hai. Boliye: "Anyway, I should get going. See you soon!" ya "Let's catch up later."

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

Hey! Long time no see!

Arre! Kitne din baad dikhe!

2

How have you been?

Itne din kaise rahe?

3

I'm good, thanks. How about you?

Main theek hoon, thanks. Aap sunao?

4

What's new with you?

Aur kya naya chal raha hai?

5

Nothing much, same old routine.

Kuch khaas nahi, wahi roz ka kaam.

6

It's really cold today, isn't it?

Aaj bahut thand hai na?

7

Anyway, I should get going.

Accha, ab mujhe chalna chahiye.

8

Take care. See you soon!

Apna dhyaan rakhna. Jaldi milte hain!

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

Two old friends at the metro stationMetro station pe do purane dost
Imran

Rahul? Hey! Long time no see!

Rahul? Arre! Kitne din baad!

Rahul

Imran! Wow, how have you been?

Imran! Wow, kaise rahe?

Imran

I'm good, thanks. Just busy with work. How about you?

Theek hoon yaar. Bas kaam mein busy. Tum sunao?

Rahul

Not bad. I've just started an English course.

Badhiya. Maine abhi English course start kiya hai.

Imran

That's great! Where are you off to?

Bahut badhiya! Kahaan ja rahe ho?

Rahul

Going to Rajiv Chowk. It's so crowded today, isn't it?

Rajiv Chowk. Aaj kitni bheed hai na?

Imran

Yes, it's always like this on Mondays.

Haan, Monday ko hamesha aisa hi hota hai.

Rahul

Oh, my train is here. I should get going.

Arre, meri train aa gayi. Chalta hoon.

Imran

Sure. Let's catch up this weekend.

Done. Is weekend milte hain.

Rahul

Definitely. Take care!

Pakka. Take care!

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

Picture TalkPicture dekhiye aur boliye

  1. Are these people friends or strangers? How do you know?
  2. What greeting would you use here: morning or evening?
  3. Start a small talk with one of them in three lines.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ I am fine, and you?

✓ I'm good, thanks. How about you?

"I am fine, and you?" robot jaisa lagta hai. Thoda natural boliye aur "thanks" jodiye.

✗ What is going on?

✓ What's up? / What's new?

Doston mein casual: "What's up?" Jawab: "Not much!"

✗ Ok bye, I am going.

✓ Anyway, I should get going. Take care!

Baat achanak khatam mat kijiye. Ek soft line se bye boliye.

Q3. Dost se bahut dino baad mile:

Confidence Tip

Small talk mein perfect English nahi, warm awaaz chahiye. Smile ke saath bola gaya "How's it going?" ek lambe sahi sentence se zyada asar karta hai.

03

Day 03  ·  Week 1  ·  Me & My World

Talking About My Family

Apni family ke baare mein batana

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap apni family ke har member ke baare mein 2-2 lines bol paoge aur doosron se unki family ke baare mein pooch paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Apne ghar ki ek photo mann mein laiye. Ghar mein kitne log hain? Sabse zyada baat kisse karte ho? Sabse funny kaun hai?

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Family intro ka easy tareeka

Pehle total log: "There are five of us in my family." Phir har insaan: kaun hai + kya karta hai + kaisa hai. "My father runs a grocery shop. He's very hardworking."

Joint family aur nuclear family

"I live in a joint family" matlab dada-dadi, chacha sab saath. "We are a small family" matlab sirf mummy-papa aur bachche. Indian baatcheet mein ye bahut kaam aata hai.

Sawaal poochna bhi seekhiye

"How many brothers and sisters do you have?", "What does your father do?", "Who are you closest to?" Ye teen sawaal kisi bhi baat ko aage badha dete hain.

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

There are five of us in my family.

Hamari family mein paanch log hain.

2

I live in a joint family.

Main joint family mein rehta/rehti hoon.

3

My father runs a small business.

Mere papa/abbu ka chhota sa business hai.

4

My mother is a homemaker.

Meri ammi/mummy ghar sambhalti hain.

5

I have one elder brother and one younger sister.

Mera ek bada bhai aur ek chhoti behen hai.

6

I'm the youngest in my family.

Main ghar mein sabse chhota/chhoti hoon.

7

I'm very close to my grandmother.

Main apni dadi/nani ke bahut close hoon.

8

What does your father do?

Aapke papa kya karte hain?

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

Talking about family over chaiChai pe family ki baatein
Sana

So Priya, do you live with your family?

Toh Priya, tum family ke saath rehti ho?

Priya

Yes, I live in a joint family. There are nine of us!

Haan, joint family mein. Hum nau log hain!

Sana

Nine! That must be fun.

Nau! Tab toh bahut maza aata hoga.

Priya

It is. My grandparents, my uncle's family and us. What about you?

Haan. Dada-dadi, chacha ki family aur hum. Aur tum?

Sana

We're a small family. Just my parents, my brother and me.

Hamari chhoti family hai. Bas ammi-abbu, bhai aur main.

Priya

Is your brother older or younger?

Bhai bada hai ya chhota?

Sana

He's older. He works as a software engineer in Noida.

Bada hai. Noida mein software engineer hai.

Priya

Nice! And what does your father do?

Nice! Aur tumhare abbu kya karte hain?

Sana

He's a school teacher. He's strict but very loving.

Wo school teacher hain. Strict hain par bahut pyaar karte hain.

Priya

Sounds like my dad. Who are you closest to?

Bilkul mere papa jaise. Tum sabse zyada kiske close ho?

Sana

My mother, definitely. She's my best friend.

Ammi ke, pakka. Wo meri best friend hain.

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

Picture TalkPicture dekhiye aur boliye

  1. How many people can you see in this family?
  2. Who do you think is the father, mother and children?
  3. Describe your own family in three sentences.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ My father is doing business.

✓ My father runs a business. / He's a businessman.

Kaam ki aadat batani ho toh "runs" ya "is a ..." boliye, "is doing" nahi.

✗ We are total five members.

✓ There are five of us in my family.

"Total five members" office wali language hai. Ghar ke liye "five of us" natural hai.

✗ My mother is housewife.

✓ My mother is a homemaker.

"a" mat chhodiye, aur "homemaker" zyada respectful word hai.

Family photo

Partner APhone mein apni family photo dikhao (ya imagine karo) aur har insaan ke baare mein batao.
Partner BHar insaan ke baare mein 1 sawaal poocho: "Who's this?", "What does she do?", "Is he older than you?"

Partner BPolitely aur confidently sab jawab do. Kisi sawaal ka jawab nahi dena ho toh bolo: "I'd rather not talk about that."

1-Minute Speaking ChallengeRukna nahi hai, bas bolte rehna hai

Homework

Aaj raat khaane pe ghar walon ko batayiye ki aap English seekh rahe ho, aur har member ke baare mein ek English line bolkar sunaiye. Unka reaction diary mein likhiye.

Confidence Tip

Apni jaani-pehchaani cheezon ke baare mein bolna sabse easy hota hai. Family pe bolte-bolte aapki zubaan khulegi, isliye aaj khoob boliye.

04

Day 04  ·  Week 1  ·  Me & My World

My Daily Routine

Meri daily routine: subah se raat tak

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap apni poori routine subah se raat tak flow mein bol paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Kal aapne subah uthne se lekar raat sone tak kya-kya kiya? Ungliyon pe 8 kaam giniye.

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Routine = roz ki aadat

Routine batate waqt har kaam ko "I + kaam" se boliye: "I wake up at six. I have tea. I take the metro." Chhote, saaf sentences.

Linking words se baat jodiye

"First, then, after that, around 2 o'clock, in the evening, finally". Inse aapki baat kahani jaisi behti hai aur sunne wale ko maza aata hai.

Time bolne ka natural tareeka

"at 7", "around 8", "by 10", "till late night". "I usually" aur "sometimes" se batayiye ki kitni baar karte ho.

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

I usually wake up at six.

Main usually chhe baje uthta/uthti hoon.

2

First, I freshen up and pray.

Sabse pehle fresh hokar namaz/pooja karta/karti hoon.

3

Then I have breakfast with my family.

Phir family ke saath nashta karta/karti hoon.

4

I leave for college at eight.

Aath baje college ke liye nikalta/nikalti hoon.

5

I get back home around five.

Karib paanch baje ghar wapas aata/aati hoon.

6

In the evening, I help my mother.

Shaam ko ammi/mummy ki help karta/karti hoon.

7

After dinner, I scroll Instagram for a while.

Dinner ke baad thodi der Instagram chalata/chalati hoon.

8

I go to bed by eleven.

Gyarah baje tak so jaata/jaati hoon.

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

Interview for a part-time jobPart-time job ke liye baatcheet
Manager

Tell me about your daily routine, Faiz.

Faiz, apni daily routine batao.

Faiz

Sure. I wake up at six and go for a short walk.

Zaroor. Main chhe baje uthta hoon aur thoda walk pe jaata hoon.

Manager

Early riser! What happens after that?

Jaldi uthne wale! Uske baad?

Faiz

Then I have breakfast and leave for college at eight.

Phir nashta karke aath baje college nikalta hoon.

Manager

When do your classes finish?

Classes kab khatam hoti hain?

Faiz

Usually by one. I'm free after two.

Usually ek baje tak. Do baje ke baad main free hoon.

Manager

So you can work from three to eight?

Toh tum teen se aath kaam kar sakte ho?

Faiz

Yes, that works for me. I study at night.

Haan, mere liye theek hai. Main raat ko padhta hoon.

Manager

And weekends?

Aur weekends?

Faiz

On Sundays I'm completely free.

Sunday ko main poora free hoon.

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

Picture TalkPicture dekhiye aur boliye

  1. What time of day is it in this picture?
  2. What are these people doing?
  3. Tell me your morning routine in five steps.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ I am waking up at 6 daily.

✓ I wake up at six every day.

Roz ki aadat ke liye "I wake up" boliye, "am waking" nahi.

✗ I do bath.

✓ I take a bath. / I take a shower.

"Bath karna" direct translate mat kijiye. English mein "take a bath".

✗ I sleep at 11 o'clock night.

✓ I go to bed at eleven.

"Go to bed" natural hai, aur "night" alag se jodne ki zaroorat nahi.

Q2. Breakfast ke baad kya karte ho, jodkar boliye:

Q3. Nahaane ke liye sahi:

Doctor's lifestyle check

Partner AAap doctor ho. Patient se poocho: kab uthte ho, kya khaate ho, exercise karte ho ya nahi, kab sote ho.
Partner BAap patient ho. Apni asli routine batao, sach-sach, chahe aap late sote ho.

Busy vs lazy

Partner AAap bahut busy insaan ho. Apna poora din jaldi-jaldi batao.
Partner BAap bahut aaram-pasand ho. Apna "lazy day" batao aur funny banao.

Jo kaam aap roz karte ho, karte waqt mann mein English mein boliye: "I'm making tea now." Ise self-talk kehte hain, aur ye fluency ka sabse fast raasta hai.

05

Day 05  ·  Week 1  ·  Me & My World

My Home & My Neighbourhood

Mera ghar aur mera mohalla

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap apne ghar, mohalle aur aas-paas ki jagahon ke baare mein kisi guest ya dost ko English mein bata paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Ghar se bahar nikalte hi aapko kya-kya dikhta hai? Dukaan, masjid/mandir, park, thela, chai wala? 5 cheezein sochiye.

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Ghar ka description

"I live in a two-room flat on the third floor." Phir kamron ke baare mein: "We have a small kitchen and a balcony." Last mein feeling: "It's small, but it's cosy."

Mohalla: kya paas hai, kya door

"There's a market right next to my building.", "The metro station is a ten-minute walk." Paas-door batane ke liye "walking distance" bahut kaam ka word hai.

Achha aur bura, dono batayiye

"The best thing about my area is the food. The worst thing is the traffic." Ye line kisi bhi baatcheet mein aapko interesting bana deti hai.

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

I live in a flat on the third floor.

Main teesri floor pe ek flat mein rehta/rehti hoon.

2

It's small, but it's very cosy.

Chhota hai, par bahut cosy hai.

3

There's a big market right next to my building.

Meri building ke bilkul paas ek bada market hai.

4

The metro station is a ten-minute walk.

Metro station paidal das minute hai.

5

My area is famous for its food.

Mera area khaane ke liye famous hai.

6

The streets get really crowded in the evening.

Shaam ko galiyon mein bahut bheed ho jaati hai.

7

The neighbours are very helpful.

Padosi bahut helpful hain.

8

The best thing about my area is ...

Mere area ki sabse achhi baat hai ...

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

A friend visits for the first timeDost pehli baar ghar aa rahi hai
Mehak

Hi Ali, I'm at the metro station. How do I reach your place?

Hi Ali, main metro station pe hoon. Tumhare ghar kaise aaun?

Ali

Take gate number 2. My building is a five-minute walk from there.

Gate number 2 se niklo. Wahan se meri building paanch minute paidal hai.

Mehak

Okay. Is there any landmark?

Okay. Koi landmark hai?

Ali

Yes, there's a big sweet shop on the corner. Turn left after it.

Haan, corner pe ek badi mithai ki dukaan hai. Uske baad left mudna.

Mehak

Got it. Which floor do you live on?

Samajh gayi. Kaunsi floor pe rehte ho?

Ali

Third floor, flat 304. Sorry, there's no lift!

Third floor, flat 304. Sorry, lift nahi hai!

Mehak

No problem. Good exercise! Your area looks so lively.

Koi baat nahi, achhi exercise! Tumhara area bahut raunak wala lagta hai.

Ali

It is! The food here is amazing, but the traffic is crazy.

Haan! Yahan ka khaana kamaal hai, par traffic pagal kar deta hai.

Mehak

Then after tea, let's try the kebabs.

Toh chai ke baad kebab try karte hain.

Ali

Deal! See you in five minutes.

Deal! Paanch minute mein milte hain.

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

Picture TalkPicture dekhiye aur boliye

  1. What kind of buildings can you see?
  2. Is this area quiet or busy? Why do you think so?
  3. Describe the street outside your home.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ My home is in third floor.

✓ My home is on the third floor.

Floor ke saath hamesha "on" boliye: on the ground floor, on the second floor.

✗ Market is very near from my house.

✓ The market is very close to my house.

"Near from" nahi bolte. "close to" ya "near my house".

✗ There is too much rush.

✓ It's very crowded.

Bheed ke liye "rush" kam bolte hain. "crowded" natural hai.

Flash CardsHinglish padhiye, English mein boliye, phir card palatiye

Q1. Aapka flat doosri manzil pe hai:

Q2. Metro paas hai, kaise bataoge?

Q3. Shaam ko bahut bheed hoti hai:

Q4. Aapke area ki sabse achhi baat:

Role-Play CardsDo-do ke pair mein, bina book dekhe

Delivery boy on the phone

Partner AAap delivery boy ho, address nahi mil raha. Landmark, floor, gali sab poocho.
Partner BAap customer ho. Landmark se samjhao ki ghar tak kaise pahunche.

House hunting

Partner AAap ek room kiraye pe lena chahte ho. Room, paani, bijli, market, metro ke baare mein poocho.
Partner BAap landlord ho. Room aur area ki tareef karo, kiraya aur rules batao.

You are a tour guide for your own area. In one minute, tell a group of foreign visitors what's special about your neighbourhood and where they should eat.

Homework

Confidence Tip

Jab koi English mein raasta ya jagah pooche, ghabraiye mat. Haath se ishaara kariye aur saath mein chhote words boliye: "Straight, then left, near the shop." Communication pehle, perfect sentence baad mein.

Day 06  ·  Week 1  ·  Me & My World

Hobbies & Free Time

Shauq aur free time ki baatein

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap apne hobbies ke baare mein dil se baat kar paoge aur doosron se unki pasand pooch paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Agar aapko poora ek din free mile aur koi kaam na ho, toh aap kya karoge? 3 cheezein sochiye.

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Like / love / enjoy / into

"I like cooking.", "I love watching cricket.", "I really enjoy reading.", "I'm really into fitness these days." Ek hi baat ko alag-alag tareeke se bolna fluency ki nishaani hai.

Sirf naam nahi, kahani batayiye

"My hobby is cooking" bolkar ruk mat jaiye. Batayiye: kab se, kyun, kya banate ho. "I started cooking during the lockdown. Now I make the best biryani in my family!"

Naapasand bhi politely

"I'm not really into video games.", "Dancing isn't my thing." Ye "I hate" se soft aur polite hain.

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

What do you do in your free time?

Free time mein aap kya karte ho?

2

I love watching cricket.

Mujhe cricket dekhna bahut pasand hai.

3

I'm really into fitness these days.

Aajkal mujhe fitness ka bahut shauq hai.

4

I started cooking during the lockdown.

Maine lockdown mein cooking start ki.

5

It helps me relax.

Isse mujhe sukoon milta hai.

6

I'm not really into video games.

Mujhe video games mein khaas interest nahi hai.

7

How often do you play?

Aap kitni baar khelte ho?

8

We should play together sometime.

Kabhi saath mein khelna chahiye.

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

Getting to know a new colleagueNaye colleague ko jaanna
Nida

So Arjun, what do you do in your free time?

Toh Arjun, free time mein kya karte ho?

Arjun

I'm really into photography. I take my camera everywhere.

Mujhe photography ka bahut shauq hai. Camera har jagah le jaata hoon.

Nida

Wow! What do you like to shoot?

Wow! Kya click karna pasand hai?

Arjun

Mostly street food and old Delhi lanes. What about you?

Zyada tar street food aur purani Dilli ki galiyan. Aur tum?

Nida

I love painting. It helps me relax after work.

Mujhe painting pasand hai. Office ke baad sukoon milta hai.

Arjun

That's lovely. How long have you been painting?

Bahut achha. Kab se painting kar rahi ho?

Nida

Since school. I also post my work on Instagram.

School se. Main apna kaam Instagram pe bhi daalti hoon.

Arjun

Send me the link! Do you play any sports?

Link bhejo! Koi sport khelti ho?

Nida

Badminton, sometimes. But I'm not very good.

Badminton, kabhi-kabhi. Par itni achhi nahi hoon.

Arjun

Me neither! We should play together sometime.

Main bhi nahi! Kabhi saath mein khelte hain.

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

Picture TalkPicture dekhiye aur boliye

  1. What activity do you think these people enjoy?
  2. Do you like outdoor or indoor hobbies?
  3. Tell your partner about a hobby you want to start.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ My hobby is to play cricket.

✓ I love playing cricket.

"My hobby is to ..." kitaabi lagta hai. "I love/enjoy + ing" boliye.

✗ I am having interest in music.

✓ I'm interested in music. / I'm into music.

"Having interest" galat hai. "interested in" ya "into".

✗ I do time pass on mobile.

✓ I spend time on my phone.

"Time pass" desi word hai, bahar log nahi samjhenge.

Flash CardsHinglish padhiye, English mein boliye, phir card palatiye

Q1. Apna hobby naturally batayiye:

Q2. Kisi cheez mein interest nahi, politely:

Hobby club

Partner AAap college ke hobby club ke head ho. Naye member se uske hobbies poocho aur club mein invite karo.
Partner BAap naye student ho. Apne 2 hobbies batao aur poocho club mein kya-kya hota hai.

Opposite friends

Partner AAapko ghar pe rehna, books, movies pasand hain. Dost ko movie night ke liye manao.
Partner BAapko bahar ghoomna, sports pasand hai. Dost ko cricket match ke liye manao.

Homework

07

Day 07  ·  Week 1  ·  Me & My World

Food & Eating Out

Khaana, restaurant aur order dena

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap restaurant mein table lene se lekar order dene aur bill maangne tak sab English mein kar paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Aapka favourite khaana kaunsa hai? Use banane mein kya-kya lagta hai? English mein kitne naam aate hain, giniye.

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Restaurant ke 4 stages

Table → Order → Khaane ke beech → Bill. Har stage ki 2 lines yaad kar lijiye, phir kahin nahi atkoge.

"Give me" nahi, "Can I have"

"Give me one biryani" rude lagta hai. Boliye: "Can I have a chicken biryani, please?" ya "I'll have the paneer tikka." Bas yahi ek change aapko polite bana deta hai.

Khaane ka taste batana

spicy, sweet, salty, too oily, delicious, fresh. "This is a bit too spicy for me.", "The kebabs are delicious!"

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

A table for four, please.

Chaar logon ke liye table, please.

2

Can I see the menu, please?

Menu dikha dijiye, please.

3

What do you recommend?

Aap kya suggest karoge?

4

I'll have a chicken biryani, please.

Mujhe ek chicken biryani chahiye.

5

Could you make it less spicy?

Thoda kam spicy bana denge?

6

Excuse me, we've been waiting for twenty minutes.

Suniye, hum bees minute se wait kar rahe hain.

7

The food was delicious.

Khaana bahut lazeez tha.

8

Can we get the bill, please?

Bill le aaiye, please.

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

Dinner at a family restaurantFamily restaurant mein dinner
Waiter

Good evening! How many people?

Good evening! Kitne log hain?

Hamza

A table for three, please.

Teen logon ki table, please.

Waiter

Please come this way. Here's the menu.

Idhar aaiye. Ye raha menu.

Hamza

Thanks. What do you recommend?

Thanks. Aap kya suggest karoge?

Waiter

Our mutton korma and butter naan are very popular.

Hamara mutton korma aur butter naan bahut popular hai.

Hamza

Great. We'll have one mutton korma, four naans and a dal.

Badhiya. Ek mutton korma, chaar naan aur ek dal.

Waiter

Anything to drink?

Peene ke liye kuch?

Hamza

Three sweet lassis, please. And please make the dal less spicy.

Teen meethi lassi. Aur dal kam spicy banana.

Waiter

Sure, sir. It'll take about fifteen minutes.

Sure sir. Karib pandrah minute lagenge.

Hamza

Excuse me, the food was delicious. Can we get the bill, please?

Suniye, khaana bahut lazeez tha. Bill le aaiye, please.

Waiter

Of course. Would you like to pay by UPI or cash?

Zaroor. UPI se doge ya cash?

Hamza

UPI, please.

UPI se.

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

Picture TalkPicture dekhiye aur boliye

  1. Where are these people and what are they doing?
  2. What do you think is on the plates?
  3. Order your favourite meal from the waiter.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ Give me one plate biryani.

✓ Can I have a plate of biryani, please?

"Give me" hukum jaisa lagta hai. "Can I have ... please?" polite hai.

✗ Bring the bill.

✓ Can we get the bill, please?

Bill bhi request ki tarah maangiye.

✗ The food is very testy.

✓ The food is very tasty. / It's delicious.

"Testy" ka matlab hai chidchida! Khaana "tasty" hota hai.

Flash CardsHinglish padhiye, English mein boliye, phir card palatiye

Q2. Khaana bahut mirchi wala hai:

Q3. Waiter se uski suggestion poochiye:

Sentence BuilderWords pe tap karke sahi sentence banaiye

Role-Play CardsDo-do ke pair mein, bina book dekhe

At a dhaba

Partner AAap waiter ho. Table do, order lo, ek dish khatam hai, kuch aur suggest karo.
Partner BAap customer ho. Poora meal order karo, ek special request karo aur end mein bill maango.

Wrong order

Partner AAapka order galat aaya hai (paneer ki jagah chicken). Politely complaint karo.
Partner BAap manager ho. Sorry bolo, sahi dish jaldi bhijwao aur free dessert offer karo.

Describe your favourite dish for one minute: what it is, how it tastes, who makes it best, and where we can eat it in Delhi.

Homework

Day 08  ·  Week 2  ·  Out in the City

Shopping & Bargaining

Shopping, price poochna aur mol-bhaav

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap kisi bhi dukaan ya mall mein size, colour, price pooch paoge, bargaining kar paoge aur saamaan exchange karwa paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Pichli baar aapne kya khareeda tha? Dukaandaar se kya-kya baat hui thi? Wahi baatcheet aaj English mein karenge.

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Dukaan ki 3 zaroori lines

"How much is this?", "Do you have it in a bigger size?", "Can I try it on?" In teen lines se 80% shopping ho jaati hai.

Bargaining, politely

"That's a bit expensive.", "Can you give me a discount?", "What's your best price?", "I'll take two if you make it 500." Smile ke saath boliye, ladai ki tarah nahi.

Exchange aur return

"I'd like to exchange this. It's too tight.", "Can I get a refund?" Bill saath rakhiye, pehle problem batayiye, phir request.

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

How much is this kurta?

Ye kurta kitne ka hai?

2

Do you have this in blue?

Ye blue colour mein hai?

3

Can I try it on?

Kya main ise pehenkar dekh sakta/sakti hoon?

4

It's a bit too tight.

Ye thoda zyada tight hai.

5

That's too expensive for me.

Ye mere liye bahut mehenga hai.

6

What's your best price?

Last price kya lagaoge?

7

Okay, I'll take it.

Theek hai, le leta/leti hoon.

8

I'd like to exchange this, please.

Mujhe ise exchange karwana hai.

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

Buying a shirt at Lajpat NagarLajpat Nagar mein shirt khareedna
Shopkeeper

Yes, sir? What are you looking for?

Haan ji, kya chahiye?

Rehan

I'm looking for a formal shirt for an interview.

Mujhe interview ke liye formal shirt chahiye.

Shopkeeper

What size?

Kaunsa size?

Rehan

Medium, I think. Do you have it in light blue?

Shayad medium. Light blue mein hai?

Shopkeeper

Yes, here you go. This is pure cotton.

Haan, ye lijiye. Pure cotton hai.

Rehan

Nice. Can I try it on?

Achhi hai. Pehenkar dekh sakta hoon?

Shopkeeper

Sure, the trial room is on the left.

Zaroor, trial room left mein hai.

Rehan

It fits well. How much is it?

Fitting achhi hai. Kitne ki hai?

Shopkeeper

Nine hundred rupees.

Nau sau rupaye.

Rehan

That's a bit expensive. What's your best price?

Thodi mehengi hai. Last price?

Shopkeeper

For you, seven fifty.

Aapke liye saadhe saat sau.

Rehan

Make it seven hundred and I'll take it.

Saat sau kar do, le leta hoon.

Shopkeeper

Okay, done!

Chalo, done!

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

Picture TalkPicture dekhiye aur boliye

  1. What is the customer buying, do you think?
  2. What will the shopkeeper say first?
  3. Bargain with the shopkeeper for this item.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ What is the rate of this?

✓ How much is this?

"Rate" sabzi mandi mein chal jaata hai, par natural sawaal hai "How much is this?"

✗ Give some less.

✓ Can you give me a discount? / Can you lower the price?

"Give some less" samajh nahi aata. Saaf boliye: discount ya lower price.

✗ Can I trial this?

✓ Can I try this on?

"Trial" noun hai. Kapdon ke liye "try on".

Flash CardsHinglish padhiye, English mein boliye, phir card palatiye

Q1. Price poochna hai:

Q2. Shirt pehenkar dekhni hai:

09

Day 09  ·  Week 2  ·  Out in the City

Asking & Giving Directions

Raasta poochna aur raasta batana

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap kisi anjaan jagah pe raasta pooch paoge aur kisi tourist ko apne area mein raasta samjha paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Apne ghar se Jamia Wallah institute tak ka raasta Hindi mein mann mein boliye. Kitne mod aate hain?

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Poochne se pehle "Excuse me"

Kisi anjaan se baat start karne ka sabse polite tareeka: "Excuse me, could you help me?" Phir: "How do I get to Jamia metro station?"

Raasta batane ke 6 magic words

go straight, turn left, turn right, take the second left, opposite, next to. Saath mein landmark: "Turn left at the petrol pump."

Confirm kariye

Raasta sunkar repeat kariye: "So, straight and then left at the petrol pump?" Aur poochiye: "Is it walking distance?"

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

Excuse me, how do I get to the metro station?

Suniye, metro station kaise jaaun?

2

Is it far from here?

Kya yahan se door hai?

3

Go straight and take the second left.

Seedha jaiye aur doosra left lijiye.

4

Turn right at the petrol pump.

Petrol pump se right mudiye.

5

It's opposite the hospital.

Ye hospital ke saamne hai.

6

It's about a five-minute walk.

Paidal karib paanch minute ka raasta hai.

7

You can't miss it.

Aap miss nahi kar sakte, saaf dikh jayega.

8

Sorry, I'm not from around here.

Sorry, main yahan ka nahi hoon.

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

A tourist near JamiaJamia ke paas ek tourist
Tourist

Excuse me, could you help me? I'm looking for Jamia Millia Islamia.

Suniye, help karenge? Main Jamia Millia Islamia dhoondh rahi hoon.

Bilal

Sure! Are you walking?

Zaroor! Aap paidal ho?

Tourist

Yes. Is it far from here?

Haan. Yahan se door hai?

Bilal

Not really. It's about a ten-minute walk.

Zyada nahi. Karib das minute paidal.

Tourist

Great. Which way should I go?

Great. Kidhar jaaun?

Bilal

Go straight down this road till the traffic light.

Isi road pe seedha traffic light tak jaiye.

Tourist

Okay, straight till the traffic light.

Okay, traffic light tak seedha.

Bilal

Then turn left. You'll see a big gate on your right.

Phir left mudiye. Right mein ek bada gate dikhega.

Tourist

So left at the light, and the gate is on the right?

Toh light pe left, aur gate right mein?

Bilal

Exactly. You can't miss it.

Bilkul. Miss nahi hoga.

Tourist

Thank you so much!

Thank you so much!

Bilal

You're welcome. Enjoy your visit!

Koi baat nahi. Enjoy kijiye!

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

Picture TalkPicture dekhiye aur boliye

  1. Who is asking for directions in this picture?
  2. What landmarks can you imagine around them?
  3. Give directions from this place to the nearest metro station.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ Where is metro station?

✓ Excuse me, where's the metro station?

"Excuse me" aur "the" jodte hi sawaal polite aur sahi dono ho jaata hai.

✗ Take left from there.

✓ Turn left there.

Mudne ke liye "turn left/right". "Take the second left" tab, jab galiyan gin rahe ho.

✗ It is in front of the hospital.

✓ It's opposite the hospital.

Road ke us paar saamne ho toh "opposite". "In front of" matlab theek aage, usi side.

Q2. Dukaan road ke us paar, hospital ke saamne hai:

Q3. Aapko raasta nahi pata:

Q4. Raasta batana hai:

Partner BAap local dukaandaar ho. Landmarks ke saath raasta samjhao.

Partner BSirf sunkar apni ungli map pe chalao. Galat lage toh poocho: "Left or right?"

Day 10  ·  Week 2  ·  Out in the City

Travel: Metro, Bus, Auto & Train

Safar: metro, bus, auto, cab aur train

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap ticket lene, auto wale se kiraya tay karne aur train/flight ki info lene mein English use kar paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Aap roz kis cheez se travel karte ho? Safar mein sabse zyada pareshani kis cheez ki hoti hai?

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Ticket counter English

"One ticket to Rajiv Chowk, please.", "A return ticket to Agra.", "Which platform does the Lucknow train leave from?" Chhoti, saaf lines.

Auto aur cab wale se baat

"How much to Okhla?", "Please go by the meter.", "Can you stop here, please?", "Please take the main road." Ye lines aapke paise bhi bachayengi.

Delay aur problem

"Is the train running late?", "I've missed my bus.", "The flight has been delayed by two hours." Problem batane se help jaldi milti hai.

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

One ticket to Rajiv Chowk, please.

Rajiv Chowk ka ek ticket dijiye.

2

Which platform does the train leave from?

Train kaunse platform se jayegi?

3

Is this the right bus for Nehru Place?

Kya ye Nehru Place wali bus hai?

4

How much to Okhla?

Okhla ka kitna loge?

5

Please go by the meter.

Meter se chaliye, please.

6

Can you stop here, please?

Yahan rok dijiye, please.

7

The train is running two hours late.

Train do ghante late chal rahi hai.

8

Is this seat taken?

Kya ye seat kisi ki hai?

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

Booking a cab and talking to the driverCab book karke driver se baat
Driver

Hello, ma'am. I've reached your location.

Hello ma'am, main aapki location pe pahunch gaya hoon.

Aisha

Hi, I'm coming. I'm wearing a black hijab, near the medical store.

Hi, aa rahi hoon. Medical store ke paas, black hijab mein hoon.

Driver

Okay, I can see you. Please share the OTP.

Okay, dikh gayi. OTP bata dijiye.

Aisha

It's 4 8 2 1. How long will it take to the airport?

4 8 2 1. Airport kitni der mein pahunchenge?

Driver

About fifty minutes. There's traffic on the Ring Road.

Karib pachaas minute. Ring Road pe traffic hai.

Aisha

My flight is at nine. Can you take a faster route?

Meri flight nau baje hai. Koi fast route lijiye?

Driver

Sure, I'll take the flyover. We'll reach by seven thirty.

Sure, flyover se chalte hain. Saadhe saat tak pahunch jayenge.

Aisha

Perfect. Could you turn the AC down a little?

Perfect. AC thoda kam kar denge?

Driver

Of course. Which terminal, ma'am?

Zaroor. Kaunsa terminal, ma'am?

Aisha

Terminal 3, please. Thank you!

Terminal 3, please. Thank you!

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

✗ Give one ticket of Agra.

Ticket hamesha "to" jagah ka hota hai, "of" nahi.

✗ Stop here only.

✓ Can you stop here, please?

"Only" Hindi ke "hi" se aata hai. English mein zaroori nahi.

✗ Train is late by two hours.

✓ The train is running two hours late.

Natural tareeka: "running late" ya "delayed by two hours".

Day 11  ·  Week 2  ·  Out in the City

At the Doctor & Chemist

Doctor aur chemist se baat

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap doctor ko apni problem saaf-saaf bata paoge aur chemist se dawai ke baare mein pooch paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Pichli baar jab aap beemar hue, kya-kya problem thi? Doctor ne kya poocha tha?

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Problem batane ka pattern

"I have a headache / fever / cough / stomach ache." Kab se: "since yesterday", "for three days". Kitni: "It's quite bad.", "It's mild."

Doctor ke common sawaal

"What seems to be the problem?", "How long have you had this?", "Are you allergic to anything?" In sawaalon ko pehchaanna zaroori hai.

Chemist pe

"Do you have something for a cold?", "How many times a day should I take this?", "Before or after food?"

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

I'm not feeling well.

Meri tabiyat theek nahi hai.

2

I've had a fever since yesterday.

Kal se bukhaar hai.

3

I have a bad headache.

Sar mein bahut dard hai.

4

My throat is sore.

Mera gala kharab hai.

5

I feel dizzy.

Mujhe chakkar aa rahe hain.

6

I'm allergic to penicillin.

Mujhe penicillin se allergy hai.

7

How many times a day should I take this?

Ye din mein kitni baar leni hai?

8

Should I take it before or after food?

Khaane se pehle ya baad mein?

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

At the clinicClinic mein
Doctor

Good morning. What seems to be the problem?

Good morning. Kya problem hai?

Kabir

I've had a fever and a sore throat since Sunday.

Sunday se bukhaar aur gala kharab hai.

Doctor

Any cough or body ache?

Khaansi ya body pain?

Kabir

Yes, a dry cough, and I feel very tired.

Haan, sookhi khaansi hai, aur bahut thakaan lagti hai.

Doctor

Let me check your temperature. It's a hundred and one.

Temperature dekhte hain. 101 hai.

Kabir

Is it serious, doctor?

Kuch serious hai, doctor?

Doctor

Don't worry, it's a viral infection. Are you allergic to any medicine?

Ghabraiye mat, viral hai. Kisi dawai se allergy hai?

Kabir

No, I'm not.

Nahi.

Doctor

Take this tablet twice a day after food, for five days.

Ye tablet din mein do baar khaane ke baad, paanch din tak.

Kabir

Should I avoid anything?

Kuch parhez?

Doctor

Avoid cold drinks. Drink warm water and get plenty of rest.

Thandi cheezein mat lijiye. Garam paani piyiye aur khoob aaram kariye.

Kabir

Thank you, doctor.

Thank you, doctor.

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

Picture TalkPicture dekhiye aur boliye

  1. Who is the doctor and who is the patient?
  2. What problem do you think the patient has?
  3. Tell the doctor about your last illness.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ I am having fever.

✓ I have a fever.

Beemari ke liye "I have a ..." natural hai.

✗ My head is paining.

✓ I have a headache. / My head hurts.

"Paining" desi English hai. "hurts" ya "ache" boliye.

✗ Doctor, give me injection.

✓ Do I need an injection, doctor?

Doctor se maangiye nahi, poochiye. Ye polite aur sahi hai.

Partner BAap patient ho. 3 problems batao: pet dard, ulti, kamzori.

Day 12  ·  Week 2  ·  Out in the City

At the Bank & Office Counters

Bank aur office counter pe baat

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap bank mein account khulwane, paise jama karne aur kisi bhi counter pe apna kaam karwane mein English bol paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Bank ya kisi sarkari office mein aap last time kab gaye the? Wahan kya kaam tha, kitni lambi line thi?

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Kaam batayiye, phir documents

"I'd like to open a savings account." Phir poochiye: "What documents do I need?" Yahi formula har counter pe chalta hai: bank, post office, college office.

Polite formal English

"I'd like to...", "Could you please...", "May I know..." Ye teen starters aapko office mein serious aur respectful dikhate hain.

Problem aur complaint

"My ATM card has been blocked.", "Money was debited but not credited.", "I'd like to register a complaint."

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

I'd like to open a savings account.

Mujhe savings account khulwana hai.

2

What documents do I need?

Kaunse documents chahiye?

3

I'd like to deposit ten thousand rupees.

Mujhe das hazaar rupaye jama karne hain.

4

Could you please update my passbook?

Meri passbook update kar denge?

5

My ATM card has been blocked.

Mera ATM card block ho gaya hai.

6

The money was debited, but the payment failed.

Paise kat gaye, par payment fail ho gayi.

7

Which counter should I go to?

Mujhe kaunse counter pe jaana chahiye?

8

How long will it take?

Kitna time lagega?

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

Opening a bank accountBank mein account khulwana
Clerk

Good morning. How may I help you?

Good morning. Batayiye kya kaam hai?

Saima

Good morning. I'd like to open a savings account.

Good morning. Mujhe savings account khulwana hai.

Clerk

Sure. Do you have your Aadhaar and PAN card?

Zaroor. Aadhaar aur PAN card hai?

Saima

Yes, I have both. Do you need photos too?

Haan, dono hain. Photo bhi chahiye?

Clerk

Yes, two passport-size photos. Please fill in this form.

Haan, do passport-size photo. Ye form bhar dijiye.

Saima

Is there a minimum balance?

Koi minimum balance hai?

Clerk

Yes, it's one thousand rupees for this account.

Haan, is account mein ek hazaar rupaye.

Saima

Okay. When will I get my debit card?

Okay. Debit card kab milega?

Clerk

In about seven working days, at your home address.

Karib saat working days mein, ghar ke address pe.

Saima

And can I use mobile banking from today?

Aur mobile banking aaj se chala sakti hoon?

Clerk

Yes, once the account is active, you'll get an SMS.

Haan, account active hote hi SMS aa jayega.

Saima

Great. Thank you for your help.

Great. Help ke liye thank you.

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

Picture TalkPicture dekhiye aur boliye

  1. Where are these people and what is the clerk doing?
  2. What documents might the customer have?
  3. Ask the clerk three questions about opening an account.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ I want to open account.

✓ I'd like to open an account.

"I'd like to" office mein zyada polite hai, aur "an" mat bhooliye.

✗ Please do the needful.

✓ Could you please help me with this?

"Do the needful" purani desi office English hai. Saaf batayiye kya chahiye.

✗ My money got cut.

✓ The money was debited from my account.

Bank mein sahi words: debited (katna), credited (aana).

Flash CardsHinglish padhiye, English mein boliye, phir card palatiye

Quick Quiz: What will you say?Sahi jawab chuniye

Q1. Bank mein apna kaam batayiye:

Q2. Poochna hai kaunse documents chahiye:

Role-Play CardsDo-do ke pair mein, bina book dekhe

Partner BAap bank officer ho. ID maango, process batao aur kitna time lagega batao.

Partner BAap office clerk ho. Transaction ID maango aur solution batao.

Day 13  ·  Week 2  ·  Out in the City

Phone Calls Made Easy

Phone pe English mein baat

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap formal aur informal dono tarah ki phone call English mein kar paoge aur zaroorat pade toh message chhod paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Phone pe English bolna aamne-saamne se zyada mushkil kyun lagta hai? Sochiye.

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Call start karna

"Hello, this is Arif speaking." (Phone pe "I am Arif" nahi, "This is Arif"). Phir: "Am I speaking to Mr. Khan?", "Is this a good time to talk?"

Jab awaaz na aaye

"Sorry, you're breaking up.", "Could you speak a little louder?", "Can I call you back?" Ye lines har call mein kaam aati hain.

Message lena aur dena

"He's not available right now. Can I take a message?", "Could you ask her to call me back?" Aur call khatam: "Thanks for calling. Bye!"

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

Hello, this is Arif speaking.

Hello, main Arif bol raha hoon.

2

Am I speaking to Mr. Khan?

Kya main Mr. Khan se baat kar raha hoon?

3

Is this a good time to talk?

Abhi baat karne ka sahi time hai?

4

Sorry, you're breaking up.

Sorry, awaaz cut ho rahi hai.

5

Could you speak a little louder?

Thoda zor se bolenge?

6

Can I call you back in ten minutes?

Das minute mein call back karun?

7

Could you ask her to call me back?

Unse kahiyega mujhe call back kar lein.

8

Thanks for calling. Have a nice day!

Call karne ke liye thanks. Aapka din achha ho!

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

Calling about a job advertisementJob ad ke baare mein call
Receptionist

Good afternoon, Sky Travels. How can I help you?

Good afternoon, Sky Travels. Batayiye?

Arif

Hello, this is Arif Hussain. I'm calling about the job ad for a ticketing executive.

Hello, main Arif Hussain. Ticketing executive wale job ad ke baare mein call kiya hai.

Receptionist

Oh yes. Please hold, I'll connect you to the HR manager.

Achha. Line pe rahiye, HR manager se jodti hoon.

Arif

Thank you.

Thank you.

Receptionist

Sorry, she's in a meeting right now. Can I take a message?

Sorry, wo abhi meeting mein hain. Message le loon?

Arif

Yes, please. Could you ask her to call me back?

Haan please. Unse call back karne ko kahiyega.

Receptionist

Sure. May I have your number?

Zaroor. Aapka number?

Arif

It's 98110 45672.

98110 45672.

Receptionist

Sorry, you're breaking up. Could you repeat that?

Sorry, awaaz cut ho rahi hai. Dobara bolenge?

Arif

Sure. Nine eight one one zero, four five six seven two.

Sure. Nine eight one one zero, four five six seven two.

Receptionist

Got it. She'll call you after four.

Mil gaya. Wo chaar baje ke baad call karengi.

Arif

Thank you so much. Have a nice day!

Thank you so much. Aapka din achha ho!

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

Picture TalkPicture dekhiye aur boliye

  1. Is this a formal or an informal call?
  2. What could the problem on the call be?
  3. Make a call to book a table at a restaurant.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ Hello, I am Arif.

✓ Hello, this is Arif.

Phone pe apne liye "This is ..." bolte hain.

✗ Who is speaking?

✓ May I know who's calling?

"Who is speaking?" thoda rude lagta hai. Formal call mein polite version boliye.

✗ I will give you a missed call.

✓ I'll give you a call. / I'll ring you.

"Missed call" India mein chalta hai, par professional call mein saaf boliye.

Flash CardsHinglish padhiye, English mein boliye, phir card palatiye

Quick Quiz: What will you say?Sahi jawab chuniye

Q1. Phone pe apna naam batana hai:

Q2. Awaaz nahi aa rahi:

Q3. Aap abhi busy ho:

Q4. Jisse baat karni thi wo nahi hai, message chhodna hai:

Score: 0 / 4

Sentence BuilderWords pe tap karke sahi sentence banaiye

Role-Play CardsDo-do ke pair mein, bina book dekhe

Customer care

Partner AAap customer ho. Aapka internet 2 din se band hai. Complaint karo aur complaint number lo.
Partner BAap customer care executive ho. Naam, number, problem poocho aur 24 ghante mein theek karne ka promise karo.

Back-to-back

Partner APartner ki taraf peeth karke baitho (phone jaisa). Doctor ka appointment lo.
Partner BAap clinic receptionist ho. Date, time, patient ka naam aur problem poocho.

1-Minute Speaking ChallengeRukna nahi hai, bas bolte rehna hai

Leave a one-minute voice message for your teacher: say who you are, why you missed yesterday's class, what you did to catch up, and ask for a call back.

Homework

Aaj kisi dost ko 2 minute ki English phone call kariye. Pehle se bata dijiye ki sirf English! Call record karke (unki permission se) suniye.

Confidence Tip

Phone pe darr isliye lagta hai kyunki chehra nahi dikhta. Iska ilaaj: pehli 2 lines pehle se tay rakhiye aur dheere boliye. Dheemi saaf awaaz = confident awaaz.

14

Day 14  ·  Week 2  ·  Out in the City

Making Plans & Invitations

Plan banana, invite karna, haan ya na kehna

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap kisi ko invite kar paoge, plan fix kar paoge aur politely mana bhi kar paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Is weekend aap kya karne wale ho? Kisi dost ko saath bulaana ho toh Hindi mein kya bologe?

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Invite karne ke tareeke

Casual: "Want to grab a coffee?", "How about a movie on Sunday?" Formal: "I'd like to invite you to my sister's wedding."

Haan bolna

"Sure, I'd love to!", "Sounds great!", "Count me in!" Phir details: "What time?", "Where should we meet?"

Mana karna bina dil tode

Formula: Thanks + Sorry + Reason + Another time. "Thanks for inviting me. I'm sorry, I can't make it. I have an exam. Maybe next weekend?"

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

Are you free this Saturday?

Kya tum is Saturday free ho?

2

How about a movie on Sunday?

Sunday ko movie kaisi rahegi?

3

I'd love to!

Bahut khushi se!

4

Count me in!

Mujhe bhi gin lo!

5

What time works for you?

Tumhe kaunsa time theek rahega?

6

Let's meet at the metro gate at six.

Chhe baje metro gate pe milte hain.

7

I'm sorry, I can't make it.

Sorry, main nahi aa paunga/paungi.

8

Maybe next time?

Shayad agli baar?

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

Planning a birthday surpriseBirthday surprise ka plan
Tanya

Hey Adil, are you free this Saturday evening?

Hey Adil, is Saturday shaam free ho?

Adil

I think so. What's the plan?

Shayad. Kya plan hai?

Tanya

It's Huma's birthday. We're planning a surprise party.

Huma ka birthday hai. Hum surprise party plan kar rahe hain.

Adil

That's a great idea! Count me in.

Zabardast idea! Mujhe bhi gin lo.

Tanya

We'll meet at Karim's restaurant at seven.

Hum saat baje Karim's restaurant mein milenge.

Adil

Perfect. What should I bring?

Perfect. Main kya laun?

Tanya

Could you get the cake? I'll arrange the decorations.

Tum cake le aaoge? Decoration main kar loongi.

Adil

Sure. Chocolate or pineapple?

Sure. Chocolate ya pineapple?

Tanya

Chocolate, definitely! And don't tell her anything.

Chocolate, pakka! Aur use kuch mat batana.

Adil

My lips are sealed. See you on Saturday!

Munh pe taala. Saturday ko milte hain!

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

Picture TalkPicture dekhiye aur boliye

  1. What is the man holding? What could it be?
  2. Is the woman saying yes or no?
  3. Invite your partner to a family function.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ Will you come in my party?

✓ Would you like to come to my party?

Party "to" aate hain, "in" nahi. Aur "Would you like to" zyada pyaara lagta hai.

✗ I can't come, I am busy.

✓ I'm sorry, I can't make it. I have an exam. Maybe next time?

Sirf "busy" rude lagta hai. Sorry + reason + next time.

✗ We will meet on 6 o'clock.

✓ We'll meet at six.

Time ke saath "at": at six, at 7:30.

Flash CardsHinglish padhiye, English mein boliye, phir card palatiye

Quick Quiz: What will you say?Sahi jawab chuniye

Q1. Dost ko movie ke liye bulaana hai:

Q2. Invitation pe khushi se haan:

Q3. Politely mana karna hai:

Q4. Milne ka time fix karna hai:

Score: 0 / 4

Sentence BuilderWords pe tap karke sahi sentence banaiye

Role-Play CardsDo-do ke pair mein, bina book dekhe

Weekend plan

Partner APartner ko Sunday picnic ke liye invite karo: jagah, time, khaana, sab fix karo.
Partner BPehle mana karo (reason do), phir time badalne pe haan bolo.

Wedding invitation

Partner AAap apni behen ki shaadi ka card dene apne teacher ke ghar gaye ho. Formally invite karo.
Partner BAap teacher ho. Mubarakbaad do, date-venue poocho aur aane ka promise karo.

1-Minute Speaking ChallengeRukna nahi hai, bas bolte rehna hai

Invite the whole class to an imaginary event you are organising (a cricket match, an Eid milan, a farewell). Tell them what, when, where, and why they shouldn't miss it. One minute.

Homework

Aaj kisi dost ko English mein WhatsApp voice note bhejkar kisi plan ke liye invite kariye. Uska jawab bhi English mein maangiye.

Confidence Tip

"No" kehna bhi ek skill hai. Politely mana karne wale ki zyada respect hoti hai. Formula yaad rakhiye: Thanks, Sorry, Reason, Next time.

Day 15  ·  Week 2  ·  Out in the City

Weather, Seasons & Festivals

Mausam, seasons aur tyohaar

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap weather pe small talk kar paoge aur apne tyohaaron ke baare mein kisi ko English mein samjha paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Aapka favourite season kaunsa hai aur kyun? Aur saal ka kaunsa tyohaar aapko sabse zyada pasand hai?

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Weather ki baat = sabse easy small talk

"It's freezing today!", "It's so humid.", "Looks like it's going to rain." Kisi se bhi baat start karne ke liye weather perfect topic hai.

Tyohaar samjhane ka formula

What + When + How. "Eid is our biggest festival. It comes after Ramadan. We wear new clothes, pray together and eat sheer khurma."

Wishes dena

"Eid Mubarak!", "Happy Diwali!", "Merry Christmas!", "Wishing you and your family a very happy Eid." Aur jawab mein "Same to you!" ki jagah "Thank you, you too!"

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

It's freezing today!

Aaj toh kadaake ki thand hai!

2

It's so hot and humid.

Bahut garmi aur umas hai.

3

Looks like it's going to rain.

Lagta hai baarish hone wali hai.

4

Winter is my favourite season.

Sardi mera favourite season hai.

5

Eid is the biggest festival in my family.

Eid hamare ghar ka sabse bada tyohaar hai.

6

We wear new clothes and visit our relatives.

Hum naye kapde pehente hain aur rishtedaaron ke ghar jaate hain.

7

Wishing you and your family a happy Diwali!

Aapko aur aapki family ko Diwali ki shubhkaamnayein!

8

Thank you, you too!

Thank you, aapko bhi!

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

A foreign student asks about festivalsEk foreign student tyohaaron ke baare mein poochti hai
Emma

It's getting so cold in Delhi! Is it always like this in November?

Delhi mein kitni thand ho rahi hai! November mein hamesha aisa hota hai?

Farah

Yes, and in December it's freezing. And foggy too!

Haan, aur December mein toh kadaake ki thand. Dhund bhi!

Emma

I saw lights everywhere last month. What was the celebration?

Pichle mahine har jagah lights thi. Kya celebration tha?

Farah

That was Diwali, the festival of lights. People light lamps and share sweets.

Wo Diwali thi, roshni ka tyohaar. Log diye jalate hain aur mithai baant-te hain.

Emma

Beautiful! Which festival do you celebrate?

Beautiful! Aap kaunsa tyohaar manati ho?

Farah

Eid is our biggest festival. It comes after a month of fasting.

Eid hamara sabse bada tyohaar hai. Ek mahine ke rozon ke baad aati hai.

Emma

What do you do on Eid?

Eid pe kya karte ho?

Farah

We pray in the morning, wear new clothes and visit relatives. And we eat lots of sheer khurma!

Subah namaz, naye kapde, rishtedaaron se milna. Aur khoob saara sheer khurma!

Emma

That sounds lovely. I'd love to try it.

Bahut pyaara lagta hai. Main bhi try karna chahungi.

Farah

Then you're invited to my home next Eid!

Toh agli Eid pe aap mere ghar invited ho!

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

Picture TalkPicture dekhiye aur boliye

  1. What festival could this be? Why do you think so?
  2. What are the people holding or giving?
  3. Describe how your family celebrates your favourite festival.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ Today weather is too cold.

✓ It's really cold today.

"Too" ka matlab hai zaroorat se zyada, shikayat wala. Normal baat mein "really/very".

✗ Same to you!

✓ Thank you, you too!

"Same to you" chalta hai par kabhi-kabhi rude sunai deta hai. "You too!" zyada warm hai.

✗ We celebrate Eid by wearing new clothes.

✓ On Eid, we wear new clothes and visit relatives.

Dono sahi hain, par chhote sentences mein bolna easy aur saaf hai.

Flash CardsHinglish padhiye, English mein boliye, phir card palatiye

Quick Quiz: What will you say?Sahi jawab chuniye

Q1. Baadal chha rahe hain:

Q2. Koi kahe "Happy Eid!":

Q3. Apne favourite season ke baare mein:

Q4. Diwali pe wish karna hai:

Score: 0 / 4

Sentence BuilderWords pe tap karke sahi sentence banaiye

Role-Play CardsDo-do ke pair mein, bina book dekhe

Festival exchange

Partner AApna tyohaar partner ko samjhao: kab, kyun, kaise manate ho, kya khaate ho.
Partner BAapka tyohaar alag hai (ya koi aur). Unke baare mein 3 sawaal poocho, phir apna batao.

Weather reporter

Partner AAap TV weather reporter ho. Delhi ka kal ka mausam batao: thand, dhund, baarish.
Partner BAap viewer ho. Call karke poocho: school/office jaana safe hai ya nahi.

1-Minute Speaking ChallengeRukna nahi hai, bas bolte rehna hai

You are a guide for foreign tourists. In one minute, describe the best season to visit Delhi and one festival they must experience, and why.

Homework

Aaj weather pe 3 logon se English mein ek-ek line boliye. Apne favourite tyohaar pe 5 lines bolkar record kariye.

Confidence Tip

Har culture mein weather aur tyohaar ki baat sabse safe aur warm topic hai. Jab bolne ko kuch na soojhe, weather se start kariye.

16

Day 16  ·  Week 3  ·  Speak Your Mind

Sharing Opinions: Agree & Disagree

Apni raay dena, agree aur disagree karna

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap kisi bhi topic pe apni opinion de paoge aur bina jhagde ke agree ya disagree kar paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Mobile phone students ke liye achha hai ya bura? 10 second mein decide kariye aur ek reason sochiye.

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Opinion shuru karne ke starters

"I think...", "In my opinion...", "Personally, I feel...", "If you ask me..." Har baar "I think" mat boliye, starters badalte rahiye.

Opinion + Reason + Example

Sirf opinion kamzor lagta hai. "I think online classes are useful (opinion) because you can study from home (reason). My cousin did a whole course on YouTube (example)."

Disagree karna, respect ke saath

"I see your point, but...", "That's true, but I think...", "I'm not sure about that." Pehle saamne wale ki baat maaniye, phir apni rakhiye.

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

In my opinion, it's a good idea.

Meri raay mein ye achha idea hai.

2

Personally, I feel that ...

Personally mujhe lagta hai ki ...

3

I totally agree with you.

Main aapse poori tarah agree karta/karti hoon.

4

That's a good point.

Ye achha point hai.

5

I see your point, but I don't agree.

Main aapki baat samajhta/samajhti hoon, par agree nahi karta/karti.

6

I'm not sure about that.

Iske baare mein mujhe pakka yakeen nahi.

7

What do you think?

Aapko kya lagta hai?

8

Let's agree to disagree.

Chalo maan lete hain ki hum dono ki raay alag hai.

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

Should students use phones in class?Kya students ko class mein phone use karna chahiye?
Sameer

What do you think about phones in class?

Class mein phone ke baare mein tumhe kya lagta hai?

Alina

Personally, I feel they're useful. We can look things up quickly.

Mujhe lagta hai useful hain. Hum cheezein jaldi search kar sakte hain.

Sameer

That's a good point, but most students just use Instagram.

Achha point hai, par zyada tar students bas Instagram chalate hain.

Alina

True, but that's a discipline problem, not a phone problem.

Sahi hai, par wo discipline ki problem hai, phone ki nahi.

Sameer

Hmm, I'm not sure about that. Phones are very distracting.

Hmm, pakka nahi pata. Phone bahut distract karte hain.

Alina

I agree they can be distracting. Maybe teachers can set some rules.

Maanti hoon distract karte hain. Shayad teachers kuch rules bana sakte hain.

Sameer

Like phones only for study apps?

Jaise sirf study apps ke liye phone?

Alina

Exactly! That way we get the benefits without the distraction.

Bilkul! Isse fayde bhi milenge aur distraction bhi nahi.

Sameer

Okay, I can agree with that.

Okay, isse main agree kar sakta hoon.

Alina

See? We found a middle path!

Dekha? Humne beech ka raasta nikaal liya!

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

Picture TalkPicture dekhiye aur boliye

  1. Do these two people agree or disagree? How can you tell?
  2. What topic could they be discussing?
  3. Give your opinion on a topic of your choice with one reason.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ I am agree with you.

✓ I agree with you.

"Agree" khud action hai, "am" mat lagaiye. Ye sabse common galti hai!

✗ According to me, ...

✓ In my opinion, ... / I think ...

"According to me" Indian English mein bahut chalta hai, par natural hai "In my opinion".

✗ You are wrong.

✓ I see your point, but I see it differently.

"You are wrong" ladai shuru karta hai. Soft disagreement zyada asar karta hai.

Flash CardsHinglish padhiye, English mein boliye, phir card palatiye

Quick Quiz: What will you say?Sahi jawab chuniye

Q1. Aap dost se poori tarah agree karte ho:

Q2. Apni raay dena hai:

Q3. Politely disagree karna hai:

Q4. Saamne wale ki raay poochni hai:

Score: 0 / 4

Sentence BuilderWords pe tap karke sahi sentence banaiye

Role-Play CardsDo-do ke pair mein, bina book dekhe

Online vs offline classes

Partner AAap online classes ke favour mein ho. 3 reasons do.
Partner BAap offline classes ke favour mein ho. Politely disagree karo aur apne 3 reasons do. End mein middle path dhoondho.

Family decision

Partner AAap chahte ho family is baar Kashmir ghoomne jaaye.
Partner BAap chahte ho family gaon jaaye. Ek doosre ko convince karo, bina gussa kiye.

1-Minute Speaking ChallengeRukna nahi hai, bas bolte rehna hai

Pick one topic: "Should girls and boys get equal pocket money?", "Is social media good for students?" or "Is cricket overrated?" Give your opinion, two reasons and one example in one minute.

Homework

Aaj ki kisi news headline pe apni opinion English mein record kariye: opinion + reason + example. 45 second se zyada.

Confidence Tip

Opinion dene mein koi galat jawab nahi hota. Jo log bolte hain "I don't know", unki koi nahi sunta. Hamesha ek side choose kariye aur reason dijiye.

17

Day 17  ·  Week 3  ·  Speak Your Mind

Polite Requests & Permission

Politely request karna aur permission lena

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap kisi se bhi politely kuch maang paoge, permission le paoge aur help offer kar paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Agar aapko teacher se chhutti chahiye, ya kisi stranger se phone charger, toh Hindi mein kitne politely maangoge?

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Request ke 3 levels

Dost se: "Can you pass the water?" Thoda polite: "Could you help me, please?" Bahut polite: "Would you mind opening the window?" Jitna anjaan insaan, utna polite level.

Permission lena

"Can I sit here?", "May I come in, sir?", "Is it okay if I leave early today?" Aur jawab: "Sure, go ahead." ya "Sorry, not right now."

Help offer karna

"Can I help you with that?", "Let me carry that for you.", "Do you need a hand?" Ye lines aapko instantly friendly bana deti hain.

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

Could you help me, please?

Kya aap meri help karenge, please?

2

Would you mind closing the door?

Agar bura na lage toh darwaza band kar denge?

3

May I come in, sir?

Kya main andar aa sakta/sakti hoon, sir?

4

Is it okay if I leave early today?

Kya main aaj jaldi ja sakta/sakti hoon?

5

Can I borrow your charger for a minute?

Ek minute ke liye aapka charger le sakta/sakti hoon?

6

Sure, go ahead.

Haan haan, bilkul.

7

Do you need a hand?

Koi help chahiye?

8

Thanks a lot, that's very kind of you.

Bahut shukriya, aap bahut achhe ho.

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

Asking the manager for a day offManager se chhutti maangna
Rizwan

Excuse me, ma'am. May I come in?

Excuse me ma'am, kya main andar aa sakta hoon?

Manager

Yes, Rizwan, come in. What is it?

Haan Rizwan, aao. Kya baat hai?

Rizwan

I wanted to ask you something. Is it okay if I take Friday off?

Aapse kuch poochna tha. Kya main Friday ki chhutti le sakta hoon?

Manager

Friday? Is everything all right?

Friday? Sab theek hai?

Rizwan

Yes, ma'am. It's my brother's engagement.

Haan ma'am. Mere bhai ki engagement hai.

Manager

Oh, congratulations! But we have the client meeting on Friday.

Arre, mubarak ho! Par Friday ko client meeting hai.

Rizwan

I know. Would you mind if Saba handles it? I'll brief her on Thursday.

Pata hai. Agar Saba handle kar le toh chalega? Main use Thursday ko brief kar dunga.

Manager

That works. Please send me the report before you leave.

Theek hai. Jaane se pehle report bhej dena.

Rizwan

Sure, I'll send it by Thursday evening. Thank you so much, ma'am.

Zaroor, Thursday shaam tak bhej dunga. Bahut shukriya ma'am.

Manager

No problem. Enjoy the function!

Koi baat nahi. Function enjoy karo!

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

Picture TalkPicture dekhiye aur boliye

  1. What is one person offering the other?
  2. Write a polite request this person might make.
  3. Ask your partner for permission to borrow something.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ Give me your pen.

✓ Could I borrow your pen, please?

"Give me" hukum lagta hai. Request mein "Could I" aur "please" lagaiye.

✗ Can I come inside?

✓ May I come in?

Class ya office mein "May I come in?" standard polite line hai.

✗ Do one thing, close the door.

✓ Could you close the door, please?

"Do one thing" Hindi ke "ek kaam karo" se aata hai. English mein seedha request kariye.

Flash CardsHinglish padhiye, English mein boliye, phir card palatiye

Quick Quiz: What will you say?Sahi jawab chuniye

Q1. Office mein boss ke cabin mein jaana hai:

Q2. Stranger se window band karwani hai:

Q3. Dost ka charger chahiye:

Q4. Kisi ko help offer karni hai:

Score: 0 / 4

Sentence BuilderWords pe tap karke sahi sentence banaiye

Role-Play CardsDo-do ke pair mein, bina book dekhe

Early leave

Partner AAap student ho. Teacher se aaj 30 minute pehle jaane ki permission lo (reason do).
Partner BAap teacher ho. Pehle reason poocho, phir ek condition ke saath haan bolo.

Neighbour favour

Partner AAap 3 din ke liye bahar ja rahe ho. Padosi se request karo ki plants ko paani de de.
Partner BAap padosi ho. Haan bolo, par 2 sawaal poocho: chaabi kahaan hai, kitna paani dena hai.

1-Minute Speaking ChallengeRukna nahi hai, bas bolte rehna hai

Make five polite requests in one minute: one to a teacher, one to a stranger, one to a shopkeeper, one to your boss and one to your mother. Change the level of politeness each time.

Homework

Aaj din bhar jo bhi cheez kisi se maangiye, "please" aur "Could you..." ke saath English mein maangiye. Kitni baar kiya, diary mein giniye.

Confidence Tip

Politeness ek magic trick hai. "Could you...please?" bolne wale ki baat log khushi se maante hain, chahe uski grammar perfect na ho.

18

Day 18  ·  Week 3  ·  Speak Your Mind

Sorry, Thank You & Complaints

Maafi maangna, shukriya kehna aur complaint karna

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap sahi tareeke se sorry bol paoge, dil se thank you bol paoge aur bina gussa kiye complaint kar paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Aakhri baar aapne kisse sorry bola tha aur kyun? Aakhri complaint kab ki thi?

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Sorry ke levels

Chhoti galti: "Oops, sorry!" Badi galti: "I'm really sorry. It was my fault." Formal: "I apologise for the delay." Aur solution: "It won't happen again."

Thank you ko special banaiye

Sirf "thanks" ki jagah reason jodiye: "Thanks for waiting.", "Thank you for your help with the form.", "I really appreciate it."

Complaint ka calm formula

Problem + Effect + Request. "My order is late (problem). I needed it for a function (effect). Could you please check it or refund me? (request)" Gussa nahi, facts.

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

I'm really sorry. It was my fault.

Main sach mein sorry hoon. Galti meri thi.

2

Sorry I'm late. The traffic was terrible.

Late hone ke liye sorry. Traffic bahut kharab tha.

3

It won't happen again.

Aisa dobara nahi hoga.

4

No worries. It's okay.

Koi baat nahi. It's okay.

5

Thank you so much for your help.

Aapki help ke liye bahut shukriya.

6

I really appreciate it.

Main iski sach mein kadar karta/karti hoon.

7

I'd like to make a complaint.

Mujhe ek complaint karni hai.

8

Could you please look into it?

Kya aap please ise check karenge?

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

A complaint at the hotel receptionHotel reception pe complaint
Guest

Excuse me, I'd like to make a complaint about my room.

Excuse me, mujhe apne room ke baare mein complaint karni hai.

Receptionist

I'm sorry to hear that, sir. What's the problem?

Sunkar afsos hua sir. Kya problem hai?

Guest

The AC isn't working, and the room is very hot.

AC kaam nahi kar raha, aur room bahut garam hai.

Receptionist

I apologise for that. Which room are you in?

Iske liye maafi chahti hoon. Aap kaunse room mein hain?

Guest

Room 214. I have an important meeting early tomorrow, so I need to sleep well.

Room 214. Kal subah zaroori meeting hai, toh achhi neend chahiye.

Receptionist

Of course. I'll send the technician right away.

Bilkul. Main abhi technician bhejti hoon.

Guest

And if it can't be fixed?

Aur agar theek nahi hua toh?

Receptionist

Then we'll move you to another room at no extra cost.

Toh hum aapko bina extra charge doosra room de denge.

Guest

Thank you. I really appreciate it.

Thank you. Main iski kadar karta hoon.

Receptionist

You're welcome, sir. Again, sorry for the trouble.

Welcome sir. Pareshani ke liye phir se sorry.

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

Picture TalkPicture dekhiye aur boliye

  1. Who is complaining and who is listening?
  2. What do you think went wrong?
  3. Make a calm complaint about a late food delivery.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ Sorry, I did mistake.

✓ Sorry, I made a mistake.

Galti "make" hoti hai, "do" nahi: make a mistake.

✗ Why your service is so bad?

✓ I'm not happy with the service. Could you please help?

Gusse wala sawaal kaam bigaadta hai. Problem aur request saaf boliye.

✗ Thanks, no need.

✓ No, thank you. I'm fine.

Kuch mana karna ho toh "No, thank you" polite hai.

Q2. Kisi ne aapki bahut help ki:

Q3. Aapne galti ki, maanna hai:

Q4. Restaurant mein khaana thanda aaya:

Broken phone

Partner AAapka naya phone ek hafte mein kharab ho gaya. Shop pe calm complaint karo (Problem + Effect + Request).
Partner BAap shop wale ho. Sorry bolo, warranty check karo aur repair ya replacement offer karo.

Forgot the birthday

Partner AAap apne best friend ka birthday bhool gaye. Dil se sorry bolo aur kuch special plan karo.
Partner BAap naraz dost ho. Pehle thoda naraz raho, phir maaf kar do.

Tell a story about a time something went wrong (a wrong order, a late train, a broken item). How did you complain? What happened? One minute.

Homework

Aaj teen logon ko "Thank you for ..." reason ke saath boliye. Ek purani galti ke liye kisi ko English mein sorry message bhejiye.

Confidence Tip

Sorry bolna kamzori nahi, strength hai. Aur gusse mein ki gayi complaint se zyada asar calm complaint ka hota hai. Awaaz neeche, facts upar.

19

Day 19  ·  Week 3  ·  Speak Your Mind

Feelings & Emotions

Apne jazbaat aur feelings batana

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap khushi, gussa, darr, tension jaisi feelings English mein bata paoge aur doosron ko comfort kar paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Aaj subah se aapne kaun-kaun si feelings mehsoos ki? Khushi, thakaan, tension, excitement? 3 naam sochiye.

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Feelings ke liye "I feel" aur "I'm"

"I'm so happy today!", "I feel nervous.", "I'm really stressed about my exams." Saath mein reason: "...because I got the job!"

Basic se aage badhiye

happy → excited, thrilled; sad → upset, heartbroken; angry → annoyed, frustrated; scared → nervous, worried. Sahi word se aapki feeling aur saaf pahunchti hai.

Doosron ko comfort karna

"What's wrong?", "Are you okay?", "Don't worry, it'll be fine.", "I'm here for you.", "Take your time." Ye lines rishte majboot karti hain.

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

I'm so excited about the trip!

Main trip ko lekar bahut excited hoon!

2

I feel a bit nervous.

Mujhe thodi ghabrahat ho rahi hai.

3

I'm really stressed about my exams.

Main exams ko lekar bahut tension mein hoon.

4

I was so upset when I heard the news.

Ye khabar sunkar main bahut dukhi ho gaya/gayi.

5

It's so annoying!

Ye kitna irritating hai!

6

Are you okay? You look worried.

Tum theek ho? Pareshan lag rahe ho.

7

Don't worry, everything will be fine.

Fikar mat karo, sab theek ho jayega.

8

I'm here for you.

Main tumhare saath hoon.

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

A friend before the resultsResult se pehle dost
Rubina

Hey Danish, are you okay? You look worried.

Hey Danish, tum theek ho? Pareshan lag rahe ho.

Danish

I'm really stressed. My results come out tomorrow.

Bahut tension hai. Kal result aa raha hai.

Rubina

Oh, I understand. How do you think your exams went?

Achha, samajh sakti hoon. Exams kaise gaye the?

Danish

Most were fine, but I'm nervous about maths.

Zyada tar theek, par maths ko lekar ghabrahat hai.

Rubina

You studied so hard. I'm sure you'll pass.

Tumne itni mehnat ki. Mujhe yakeen hai pass ho jaoge.

Danish

I hope so. My parents have big expectations.

Umeed hai. Ammi-abbu ko bahut ummeedein hain.

Rubina

Don't worry. Whatever happens, they'll be proud of your effort.

Fikar mat karo. Jo bhi ho, wo tumhari mehnat pe proud honge.

Danish

Thanks, Rubina. I feel a little better now.

Thanks Rubina. Ab thoda better feel ho raha hai.

Rubina

Let's go for a walk. It'll calm you down.

Chalo walk pe chalte hain. Mann shaant hoga.

Danish

Good idea. I'm glad you're here.

Achha idea. Accha hai tum ho.

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

Picture TalkPicture dekhiye aur boliye

  1. How do you think each person is feeling?
  2. What could have happened just before this moment?
  3. Comfort the person who looks upset.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ I am feeling boring.

✓ I'm feeling bored.

"Bored" = aapko boriyat ho rahi hai. "Boring" = aap doosron ko bore karte ho! Dhyaan rakhiye.

✗ I am very much tensed.

✓ I'm really stressed. / I'm worried.

"Tensed" desi English hai. "stressed" ya "worried" boliye.

✗ Don't take tension.

✓ Don't worry. / Relax.

"Take tension" Hindi se direct translate hai.

Flash CardsHinglish padhiye, English mein boliye, phir card palatiye

Q2. Dost pareshan lag raha hai:

Q3. Dost ko comfort karna hai:

Q4. Kal job interview hai:
