Sentence BuilderWords pe tap karke sahi sentence banaiye

Role-Play CardsDo-do ke pair mein, bina book dekhe

Good news, bad news

Partner AAapke paas ek good news hai (naukri mili!). Excitement ke saath batao.
Partner BAapke paas ek bad news hai (phone kho gaya). Dono ek doosre ki feeling pe react karo.

Agony aunt

Partner AAap "Ask Didi/Bhaiya" ho. Logon ki problems sunkar advice do.
Partner BAap apni ek problem batao: exam stress, ghar mein ladai, ya dost naraz hai.

Talk about the happiest day of your life: what happened, who was there, and how you felt. Use at least four feeling words. One minute.

Homework

Aaj raat apni "feelings diary" English mein likhiye: aaj kab khush hue, kab irritate hue, kab nervous hue, aur kyun.

Confidence Tip

Apni feelings English mein bolna sabse personal practice hai. Jab dil se bolte ho, grammar ki fikar khud kam ho jaati hai aur fluency badhti hai.

Day 20  ·  Week 3  ·  Speak Your Mind

Telling a Story: My Experience

Apni kahani sunana, purane experience batana

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap apne saath hua koi bhi kissa shuru se end tak interesting tareeke se suna paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Aapki life ka koi funny ya darawna kissa yaad kariye. Kab hua tha, kahaan, kaun saath tha?

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Kahani ka 4-part structure

Setting (kab, kahaan) → Problem (kya hua) → Climax (sabse bada moment) → Ending (kya seekha). "Last summer, I was travelling to Lucknow. Suddenly, the train stopped in the middle of nowhere..."

Story ko zinda karne wale words

"Suddenly...", "Guess what?", "Then, out of nowhere...", "You won't believe it, but...", "In the end..." Ye words sunne wale ko baandh lete hain.

Beeti baat ka tone

Beeti baat mein "went, saw, met, said, was, were" use hote hain. Rule ratne ki zaroorat nahi, bas aaj ki lines dhyaan se suniye aur copy kariye.

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

This happened last year.

Ye pichle saal hua tha.

2

I was on my way to college.

Main college ja raha/rahi tha/thi.

3

Suddenly, it started raining heavily.

Achanak tez baarish shuru ho gayi.

4

You won't believe what happened next!

Aage jo hua, aap yakeen nahi karoge!

5

I didn't know what to do.

Mujhe samajh nahi aaya kya karun.

6

Luckily, a stranger helped me.

Kismat se ek anjaan insaan ne meri help ki.

7

In the end, everything worked out.

Aakhir mein sab theek ho gaya.

8

I learned a big lesson that day.

Us din maine ek bada sabak seekha.

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

The lost wallet storyKhoye hue wallet ki kahani
Uzma

You look happy today! What happened?

Aaj bade khush lag rahe ho! Kya hua?

Yusuf

You won't believe it. Remember I lost my wallet last week?

Yakeen nahi karogi. Yaad hai pichle hafte mera wallet kho gaya tha?

Uzma

Yes! You were so upset.

Haan! Tum kitne pareshan the.

Yusuf

I was on my way home in an auto. I left it on the seat by mistake.

Main auto mein ghar ja raha tha. Galti se seat pe chhod diya.

Uzma

Oh no! Did it have your cards?

Oh no! Usme cards the?

Yusuf

Everything! My Aadhaar, my debit card and three thousand rupees.

Sab kuch! Aadhaar, debit card aur teen hazaar rupaye.

Uzma

So what happened?

Phir kya hua?

Yusuf

Yesterday, the auto driver came to my house and returned it!

Kal wo auto wala mere ghar aaya aur wallet lauta diya!

Uzma

No way! How did he find you?

Kya baat! Usne tumhe kaise dhoondha?

Yusuf

He saw the address on my Aadhaar card. Nothing was missing.

Aadhaar card pe address dekha. Kuch bhi gayab nahi tha.

Uzma

That's amazing. There are still good people in the world.

Kamaal hai. Duniya mein abhi bhi achhe log hain.

Yusuf

Exactly. I learned a big lesson that day: always check the seat!

Bilkul. Us din bada sabak seekha: seat hamesha check karo!

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

Picture TalkPicture dekhiye aur boliye

  1. What do you think happened to these people yesterday?
  2. Make up a short story about this picture.
  3. Tell your partner about something that happened to you last week.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ Yesterday I go to market.

✓ Yesterday, I went to the market.

Beeti baat mein "went". "Yesterday I go" sabse common galti hai.

✗ I have seen him yesterday.

✓ I saw him yesterday.

"Yesterday" ke saath simple "saw", "have seen" nahi.

✗ Then, then, then...

✓ Then... After that... Suddenly... In the end...

Har line "then" se shuru mat kariye. Linking words badalte rahiye.

Flash CardsHinglish padhiye, English mein boliye, phir card palatiye

Quick Quiz: What will you say?Sahi jawab chuniye

Q1. Kal aap market gaye the:

Q2. Kahani mein suspense lana hai:

Q3. Story khatam karni hai:

Q4. Aapko samajh nahi aaya kya karna hai:

Score: 0 / 4

Sentence BuilderWords pe tap karke sahi sentence banaiye

Role-Play CardsDo-do ke pair mein, bina book dekhe

Story chain

Partner AAap kahani ki pehli 2 lines bolo: "Last night, I heard a strange noise..."
Partner BAap aage ki 2 lines jodo. Baari-baari 2 minute tak kahani chalao aur ek mazedaar end do.

Police report

Partner AAap police officer ho. Witness se poocho: kab, kahaan, kya hua, kaun tha.
Partner BAapne ek chain-snatching dekhi. Sab kuch detail mein batao.

1-Minute Speaking ChallengeRukna nahi hai, bas bolte rehna hai

Tell the class the funniest or scariest thing that ever happened to you. Use the 4-part structure and at least three story words (suddenly, luckily, in the end). One minute.

Homework

Ghar pe kisi bade (dada-dadi, ammi-abbu) se unki koi purani kahani suniye. Use English mein retell karke record kariye.

Confidence Tip

Achhe storytellers perfect English nahi bolte, wo emotion ke saath bolte hain. Awaaz upar-neeche kariye, pause lijiye, aur sunne walon ki aankhon mein dekhiye.

Day 21  ·  Week 3  ·  Speak Your Mind

Future Plans & Dreams

Aage ke plans aur sapne

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap apne career plans, sapne aur goals confidently English mein bata paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

5 saal baad aap khud ko kahaan dekhte ho? Kya kaam kar rahe hoge? Kahaan rah rahe hoge?

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Plans ke liye 3 starters

Pakka plan: "I'm going to start a course next month." Sapna: "I'd love to open my own boutique." Goal: "My goal is to crack the bank exam."

Short-term aur long-term

"In the short term, I want to improve my English. In the long term, I want to work in an MNC." Interview mein ye line bahut kaam aati hai.

Sapne + Plan = Strong answer

Sirf sapna nahi, plan bhi batayiye: "I want to be a teacher, so I'm preparing for B.Ed and teaching tuition in the evenings."

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

I'm going to join a computer course next month.

Main agle mahine computer course join karne wala/wali hoon.

2

My goal is to get a government job.

Mera goal sarkari naukri lena hai.

3

I'd love to start my own business one day.

Main ek din apna business shuru karna chahunga/chahungi.

4

In five years, I see myself as a manager.

Paanch saal mein main khud ko manager dekhta/dekhti hoon.

5

I'm saving money for it.

Main iske liye paise bacha raha/rahi hoon.

6

My dream is to take my parents for Hajj.

Mera sapna ammi-abbu ko Hajj pe le jaana hai.

7

I'm working hard to make it happen.

Ise poora karne ke liye mehnat kar raha/rahi hoon.

8

What are your plans for the future?

Aapke future ke kya plans hain?

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

Career talk with a mentorMentor ke saath career ki baat
Mentor

So, Nazia, what are your plans after graduation?

Toh Nazia, graduation ke baad kya plans hain?

Nazia

I'm going to apply for jobs in the airline industry.

Main airline industry mein jobs ke liye apply karne wali hoon.

Mentor

Interesting! Why airlines?

Interesting! Airlines hi kyun?

Nazia

I love meeting new people, and I'd love to travel the world.

Mujhe naye logon se milna pasand hai, aur duniya ghoomna chahti hoon.

Mentor

That's a great reason. What's your long-term goal?

Badhiya reason. Long-term goal kya hai?

Nazia

In ten years, I see myself as a cabin crew manager.

Das saal mein main khud ko cabin crew manager dekhti hoon.

Mentor

How are you preparing for it?

Uske liye taiyari kaise kar rahi ho?

Nazia

I'm working on my English and my confidence. That's why I joined this course.

English aur confidence pe kaam kar rahi hoon. Isliye ye course join kiya.

Mentor

Smart move. Anything else?

Smart move. Aur kuch?

Nazia

I'm also going to do a grooming course in January.

January mein grooming course bhi karne wali hoon.

Mentor

With this attitude, I'm sure you'll make it.

Is attitude ke saath, mujhe yakeen hai tum kar logi.

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

Picture TalkPicture dekhiye aur boliye

  1. What do you think this person is aiming for?
  2. What does the target in the picture mean to you?
  3. Tell your partner your biggest dream and your plan for it.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ I will became a doctor.

✓ I'm going to become a doctor. / I want to become a doctor.

"Will" ke baad "become", "became" nahi. Aur pakke plan ke liye "going to".

✗ My aim is to become engineer.

✓ My aim is to become an engineer.

Profession se pehle "a/an": a teacher, an engineer, a doctor.

✗ In future I will do job.

✓ In the future, I want to work in a bank.

"Do job" adhoora lagta hai. Batayiye kahaan aur kya kaam.

Q2. Aapka sapna:

Partner BAap purane classmate ho. Unki success pe sawaal poocho aur apni life batao.

Shark Tank pitch

Day 22  ·  Week 3  ·  Speak Your Mind

Phones, Social Media & Tech

Mobile, social media aur technology ki baatein

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap phone, apps, social media aur tech problems ke baare mein aaram se English mein baat kar paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Aap din mein kitne ghante phone pe rehte ho? Sabse zyada kaunsi app chalate ho?

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Roz ki tech English

"My phone is out of charge.", "The Wi-Fi isn't working.", "Can you send me the link?", "I'll WhatsApp you.", "Check your DMs." Ye lines aap roz bol sakte ho.

Social media pe opinion

"I spend too much time on reels.", "Social media is great for learning, but it's addictive." Balanced opinion aapko smart dikhata hai.

Tech problem samjhana

"My phone keeps hanging.", "The app crashes every time I open it.", "I forgot my password." Problem saaf bataoge toh solution jaldi milega.

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

My phone is out of charge.

Mera phone discharge ho gaya hai.

2

Can you send me the link?

Mujhe link bhej doge?

3

I'll WhatsApp you the details.

Main details WhatsApp kar dunga/dungi.

4

The Wi-Fi isn't working.

Wi-Fi nahi chal raha.

5

My phone keeps hanging.

Mera phone baar-baar hang hota hai.

6

I forgot my password.

Main apna password bhool gaya/gayi.

7

I spend too much time on reels.

Main reels pe bahut zyada time lagata/lagati hoon.

8

Let's take a selfie!

Chalo ek selfie lete hain!

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

Phone trouble at the service centreService centre pe phone ki problem
Executive

Hi, how can I help you today?

Hi, aaj kaise help karun?

Salman

My phone keeps hanging, and the battery drains really fast.

Mera phone baar-baar hang hota hai, aur battery bahut jaldi khatam hoti hai.

Executive

How old is the phone?

Phone kitna purana hai?

Salman

About a year. It's still under warranty.

Karib ek saal. Abhi warranty mein hai.

Executive

Okay. Have you updated the software recently?

Okay. Recently software update kiya hai?

Salman

No, I keep getting the notification, but I ignore it.

Nahi, notification aata rehta hai, par main ignore kar deta hoon.

Executive

That could be the problem. Also, how much storage is free?

Yahi problem ho sakti hai. Aur storage kitni free hai?

Salman

Almost nothing. It's full of WhatsApp videos!

Lagbhag kuch nahi. WhatsApp videos se bhari hai!

Executive

Let's back up your photos, clear some space and update it.

Photos ka backup lete hain, thodi jagah khaali karte hain aur update karte hain.

Salman

How long will it take?

Kitna time lagega?

Executive

About forty minutes. You can wait here or come back later.

Karib chaalis minute. Yahan wait kar lijiye ya baad mein aaiye.

Salman

I'll wait. Thanks for your help!

Main wait karta hoon. Help ke liye thanks!

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

Picture TalkPicture dekhiye aur boliye

  1. What is this person doing on the phone?
  2. What do you think the messages on the screen say?
  3. Describe your phone habits in three sentences.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ My phone is discharged.

✓ My phone is out of charge. / My battery is dead.

"Discharged" hospital ke liye hota hai! Phone ke liye "out of charge".

✗ Do one missed call.

✓ Give me a missed call.

Missed call "give" kiya jaata hai.

✗ Net is not coming.

✓ The internet isn't working. / There's no network.

"Not coming" Hindi translation hai.

Q2. Dost se link maangna hai:

Partner BAap dadi/nani ho. Har step pe confuse ho jao aur sawaal poocho.

Day 23  ·  Week 3  ·  Speak Your Mind

College Life & Classroom English

College life aur classroom wali English

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap class mein doubt pooch paoge, teacher se baat kar paoge aur classmates ke saath English mein discuss kar paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Class mein aapko kuch samajh nahi aaya toh kya aap haath uthate ho? Agar nahi, toh kya darr lagta hai?

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Doubt poochne ki himmat

"Excuse me, sir, I have a doubt." (India mein chalta hai) ya international: "Sorry, I have a question." Phir: "Could you explain that again, please?"

Classmates ke saath

"Did you finish the assignment?", "Can you share your notes?", "Let's study together for the test." Group study English mein karne se dono ka fayda.

Teacher se formal baat

"Sir, could I submit the assignment tomorrow?", "Ma'am, I missed the last class. What did we cover?" Polite + clear.

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

Sorry, I have a question.

Sorry, mera ek sawaal hai.

2

Could you explain that again, please?

Kya aap ise dobara samjha denge?

3

I didn't quite get that part.

Wo part mujhe theek se samajh nahi aaya.

4

When is the assignment due?

Assignment kab tak jama karna hai?

5

Can you share your notes with me?

Kya tum apne notes share karoge?

6

I missed the last class. What did we cover?

Main pichli class miss kar gaya/gayi. Kya padhaya gaya?

7

Let's study together for the test.

Chalo test ke liye saath padhte hain.

8

Could I have a few more days, please?

Kya mujhe kuch din aur mil sakte hain?

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

After class with the teacherClass ke baad teacher se baat
Shabnam

Excuse me, ma'am. Do you have a minute?

Excuse me ma'am. Aapke paas ek minute hai?

Teacher

Sure, Shabnam. What is it?

Haan Shabnam. Kya baat hai?

Shabnam

I didn't quite get the part about the balance sheet.

Mujhe balance sheet wala part theek se samajh nahi aaya.

Teacher

No problem. Which part exactly?

Koi baat nahi. Kaunsa part exactly?

Shabnam

Why do assets and liabilities always match?

Assets aur liabilities hamesha barabar kyun hote hain?

Teacher

Good question! Think of it like this: everything the company owns comes from somewhere.

Achha sawaal! Aise socho: company ke paas jo bhi hai, wo kahin se toh aaya hai.

Shabnam

Oh, I see! That makes sense now.

Achha! Ab samajh aaya.

Teacher

Great. Anything else?

Great. Aur kuch?

Shabnam

Yes. Could I submit the assignment on Monday? I was sick last week.

Haan. Kya main assignment Monday ko jama kar sakti hoon? Pichle hafte beemar thi.

Teacher

All right, Monday is fine. But no later than that.

Theek hai, Monday chalega. Par usse late nahi.

Shabnam

Thank you so much, ma'am.

Bahut shukriya ma'am.

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

✗ Sir, I am not understanding.

✓ Sorry, sir, I didn't understand that.

"Not understanding" ki jagah "didn't understand" ya "I don't understand".

✗ Ma'am, repeat again.

✓ Could you repeat that, please?

"Repeat" mein "again" pehle se hai. Aur "please" mat bhooliye.

✗ Please give me leave for two days.

✓ Could I take two days off, please?

Seedha aur polite request zyada achhi lagti hai.

Partner BAap fresher ho. Thoda nervous ho, par sawaal poocho: canteen, library, best teacher.

Day 24  ·  Week 4  ·  Career & Interviews

Workplace English

Office aur kaam ki jagah wali English

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap office mein colleagues aur boss se roz ki baatcheet, updates aur meetings English mein handle kar paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Office ya dukaan mein boss se baat karte waqt aap sabse zyada kis cheez se darte ho? Galti karne se, ya kuch na samajhne se?

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Roz ka update dena

"I've finished the report.", "I'm working on the client list.", "I'll send it by 5 p.m." Kya ho gaya, kya chal raha hai, kab tak hoga. Bas teen cheezein.

Help maangna aur dena

"Could you show me how to do this?", "I'm stuck on this. Do you have a minute?", "Let me know if you need any help." Team mein ye lines aapko pyaara bana deti hain.

Meeting English

"Can I add something?", "Sorry to interrupt, but...", "Just to confirm, the deadline is Friday?" Meeting mein chup mat rahiye, ek line toh boliye.

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

I've finished the report.

Maine report complete kar li hai.

2

I'm working on it right now.

Main abhi uspe kaam kar raha/rahi hoon.

3

I'll send it by five o'clock.

Paanch baje tak bhej dunga/dungi.

4

I'm stuck on this. Do you have a minute?

Main isme atak gaya/gayi hoon. Aapke paas ek minute hai?

5

Just to confirm, the deadline is Friday?

Bas confirm kar raha/rahi hoon, deadline Friday hai na?

6

Can I add something?

Kya main kuch add kar sakta/sakti hoon?

7

Sorry to interrupt, but ...

Beech mein bolne ke liye sorry, par ...

8

Let me know if you need any help.

Koi help chahiye ho toh batana.

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

Morning update with the team leaderTeam leader ke saath morning update
Team Leader

Good morning, Adnan. How's the sales report coming along?

Good morning Adnan. Sales report kahaan tak pahunchi?

Adnan

Good morning. I've finished the first part. I'm working on the charts now.

Good morning. Pehla part ho gaya. Abhi charts pe kaam kar raha hoon.

Team Leader

Great. When can I have it?

Great. Mujhe kab tak milegi?

Adnan

I'll send it by four o'clock.

Chaar baje tak bhej dunga.

Team Leader

Perfect. Any problems?

Perfect. Koi problem?

Adnan

Actually, yes. I'm stuck on the October numbers. They don't match.

Actually haan. October ke numbers mein atak gaya hoon. Match nahi ho rahe.

Team Leader

Ask Kavita. She handled October.

Kavita se poocho. October unhone dekha tha.

Adnan

Okay, I will. And just to confirm, the client meeting is tomorrow at eleven?

Okay, poochta hoon. Aur confirm kar loon, client meeting kal gyarah baje hai?

Team Leader

Yes, and I'd like you to present the report.

Haan, aur main chahti hoon report tum present karo.

Adnan

Sure, I'll be ready. Thanks for the opportunity!

Zaroor, main ready rahunga. Mauka dene ke liye thanks!

✗ I have completed it yesterday.

✓ I completed it yesterday. / I've completed it.

"Yesterday" ke saath "completed"; bina time ke "I've completed it".

✗ Please revert back.

✓ Please reply. / Please get back to me.

"Revert back" desi office English hai. Natural: "get back to me".

✗ I will do it from tomorrow.

✓ I'll start it tomorrow.

"From tomorrow" Hindi ka "kal se" hai. "Start tomorrow" saaf hai.

Day 25  ·  Week 4  ·  Career & Interviews

Interview Day 1: Tell Me About Yourself

Interview ka pehla sawaal: apne baare mein batao

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aapke paas ek polished 1-minute "Tell me about yourself" answer hoga jo aap kisi bhi interview mein confidently bol paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Agar kal aapka interview ho, toh pehle 10 second mein kya bologe? Kya aap apna naam, padhai, aur ek strength bata paoge?

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Interview shuru hone se pehle

Andar jaate hi: "Good morning. May I come in?", baithne se pehle: "Thank you." Smile, eye contact, seedhe baithiye. Pehle 30 second mein impression ban jaata hai.

"Tell me about yourself" ka formula: Present → Past → Future

Present: "I'm a B.Com graduate from Delhi University." Past: "I've worked part-time at a retail store, where I handled customers and billing." Future: "Now I'm looking for a role in banking, where I can grow."

Kya NAHI bolna

Poori family history, papa ka naam, apne hobbies ki lambi list, ya resume ki har line. Interviewer sirf ye jaanna chahta hai: aap kaun ho aur is job ke liye kyun sahi ho.

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

Good morning. May I come in?

Good morning. Kya main andar aa sakta/sakti hoon?

2

Thank you for having me.

Mujhe bulaane ke liye shukriya.

3

I've recently completed my graduation in commerce.

Maine abhi commerce mein graduation complete ki hai.

4

I've worked part-time as a sales executive.

Maine part-time sales executive ka kaam kiya hai.

5

I'm good at dealing with customers.

Main customers ko achhe se handle kar leta/leti hoon.

6

I'm a quick learner and a team player.

Main jaldi seekhta/seekhti hoon aur team mein achha kaam karta/karti hoon.

7

I'm looking for a role where I can grow.

Main aisa role dhoondh raha/rahi hoon jahan main grow kar sakun.

8

That's a little about me.

Ye tha thoda sa mere baare mein.

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

The first two minutes of an interviewInterview ke pehle do minute
Candidate

Good morning, sir. May I come in?

Good morning sir. Kya main andar aa sakta hoon?

Interviewer

Good morning. Yes, please come in and have a seat.

Good morning. Haan, aaiye baithiye.

Candidate

Thank you, sir.

Thank you sir.

Interviewer

So, Zaid, tell me about yourself.

Toh Zaid, apne baare mein batao.

Candidate

Sure. I'm Zaid Ahmed, and I've recently completed my B.Com from Delhi University.

Zaroor. Main Zaid Ahmed hoon, aur maine abhi Delhi University se B.Com complete kiya hai.

Candidate

For the last year, I've worked part-time at a mobile store, where I handled billing and helped customers choose phones.

Pichle ek saal se main ek mobile store pe part-time kaam kar raha hoon, jahan billing aur customers ko phone choose karne mein help karta tha.

Candidate

That job taught me how to talk to people and stay calm under pressure.

Us job ne mujhe logon se baat karna aur pressure mein calm rehna sikhaya.

Candidate

Now I'm looking for a customer service role in a company like yours, where I can learn and grow.

Ab main aapki jaisi company mein customer service role dhoondh raha hoon, jahan seekh aur grow kar sakun.

Interviewer

Good. Why customer service?

Achha. Customer service hi kyun?

Candidate

Because I enjoy solving people's problems, and I'm good at it.

Kyunki mujhe logon ki problems solve karna achha lagta hai, aur main isme achha hoon.

Interviewer

That's a good start.

Achhi shuruaat hai.

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

  1. Who is the interviewer and who is the candidate?
  2. What is the candidate doing right? What could be better?
  3. Answer "Tell me about yourself" for the job of your dreams.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ Myself Zaid, my father's name is ...

✓ I'm Zaid Ahmed. I've recently completed my B.Com.

Interview mein "Myself" aur family details mat dijiye. Seedha apni padhai aur skills pe aaiye.

✗ I am fresher.

✓ I'm a fresher. / I've just completed my graduation.

"a" lagaiye, ya positive tareeke se boliye ki abhi graduation complete ki hai.

✗ I want this job because I need money.

✓ I want this job because I can learn and grow here.

Paisa sabko chahiye, par interview mein growth aur skills ki baat kariye.

The nervous candidate

Day 26  ·  Week 4  ·  Career & Interviews

Interview Day 2: Strengths, Weaknesses & Why You

Interview ke tough sawaal: strengths, weaknesses, aur aap hi kyun

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap interview ke sabse common tricky sawaalon ke smart, honest answers de paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Aapki sabse badi achhai kya hai? Aur ek aadat jo aap sudhaarna chahte ho? Imaandaari se sochiye.

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Strength = Quality + Proof

Sirf "I'm hardworking" boring hai. Proof dijiye: "I'm very organised. In my last job, I managed the stock register for 300 products without a single mistake."

Weakness = Real + Fixing it

"I have no weakness" kabhi mat boliye. Asli weakness + aap kya kar rahe ho: "I used to be nervous speaking in English, so I joined an English course and practise every day."

"Why should we hire you?"

Teen cheezein jodiye: aapki skill + aapka experience + aapka attitude. "I have good communication skills, I've handled customers before, and I'm eager to learn. I can start contributing from day one."

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

My biggest strength is that I'm very organised.

Meri sabse badi strength ye hai ki main bahut organised hoon.

2

For example, in my last job, I ...

Jaise, apni pichli job mein maine ...

3

One area I'm working on is public speaking.

Ek cheez jis pe main kaam kar raha/rahi hoon wo hai public speaking.

4

I'm improving it by practising every day.

Main roz practice karke ise improve kar raha/rahi hoon.

5

I work well under pressure.

Main pressure mein bhi achha kaam karta/karti hoon.

6

I'm eager to learn new things.

Mujhe nayi cheezein seekhne ka bahut shauq hai.

7

You should hire me because ...

Aapko mujhe isliye hire karna chahiye kyunki ...

8

I can start contributing from day one.

Main pehle din se contribute kar sakta/sakti hoon.

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

The tough questionsMushkil sawaal
Interviewer

What would you say is your biggest strength?

Aapki sabse badi strength kya hai?

Fatima

I'd say I'm very patient with people.

Main kahungi ki main logon ke saath bahut patient hoon.

Fatima

For example, at my aunt's boutique, I handled difficult customers and turned many of them into regular buyers.

Jaise, apni khala ke boutique mein maine mushkil customers ko handle kiya aur kai ko regular customer bana diya.

Interviewer

Impressive. And your weakness?

Impressive. Aur aapki weakness?

Fatima

Honestly, I used to hesitate while speaking English in front of people.

Sach kahun toh, pehle main logon ke saamne English bolne mein jhijhakti thi.

Fatima

So I joined a spoken English course, and now I practise every day. I'm much more confident now.

Toh maine spoken English course join kiya, aur ab roz practice karti hoon. Ab kaafi zyada confident hoon.

Interviewer

Good. Why should we hire you?

Achha. Hum aapko kyun hire karein?

Fatima

I have experience with customers, I stay calm under pressure, and I'm eager to learn.

Mujhe customers ka experience hai, main pressure mein calm rehti hoon, aur seekhne ka shauq hai.

Fatima

I believe I can start contributing from day one.

Mujhe yakeen hai main pehle din se contribute kar sakti hoon.

Interviewer

Thank you, Fatima. That was a very clear answer.

Thank you Fatima. Bahut clear jawab tha.

Ab partner ke saath yahi baatcheet boliye, phir roles badaliye. Apna asli naam aur details daaliye.

Picture TalkPicture dekhiye aur boliye

  1. Does the candidate look confident? Why or why not?
  2. What question do you think the interviewer just asked?
  3. Answer "What is your biggest strength?" with a real example.

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ I don't have any weakness.

✓ One area I'm working on is ... and I'm improving it by ...

Ye jawab overconfident ya jhooth lagta hai. Asli weakness + improvement batayiye.

✗ My weakness is I work too hard.

✓ One area I'm working on is time management.

Ye purana "smart" jawab ab sab interviewers pakad lete hain. Real rahiye.

✗ Hire me, I need this job very badly.

✓ I have the skills, the experience and the attitude this role needs.

Majboori nahi, value batayiye. Company ko kya fayda hoga?

Sentence BuilderWords pe tap karke sahi sentence banaiye

Role-Play CardsDo-do ke pair mein, bina book dekhe

Rapid fire

Partner BAap candidate ho. Har sawaal ka 20-30 second ka jawab do, bina "umm" ke.

Trap question

Partner AAap tricky interviewer ho. Poocho: "Why did you get low marks in 12th?" ya "Why the gap year?"
Partner BAap candidate ho. Imaandaari se jawab do aur positive cheez pe end karo.

1-Minute Speaking ChallengeRukna nahi hai, bas bolte rehna hai

Confidence Tip

Day 27  ·  Week 4  ·  Career & Interviews

Interview Day 3: HR Round & Final Questions

HR round, salary ki baat aur interviewer se sawaal

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap HR round ke sawaal, salary discussion aur interview ka end confidently handle kar paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Agar HR pooche "What are your salary expectations?" toh aap kya bologe? Kya aap number bologe ya ghabra jaoge?

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Salary ki baat, smartly

Research karke ek range boliye: "Based on my skills and the market, I'm expecting between 18 and 22 thousand a month." Ya flexible rahiye: "I'm open to discussion. What's the budget for this role?"

Common HR sawaal

"Are you comfortable with night shifts?", "When can you join?", "Why did you leave your last job?", "Where do you see yourself in five years?" Har sawaal ka jawab positive rakhiye.

End mein aap bhi poochiye

Jab poochein "Do you have any questions for us?", kabhi "No" mat boliye. Poochiye: "What does a typical day look like in this role?", "What are the next steps?"

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

I'm expecting around twenty thousand a month.

Main mahine ke karib bees hazaar expect kar raha/rahi hoon.

2

I'm open to discussion.

Main baat karne ke liye open hoon.

3

I can join within two weeks.

Main do hafte mein join kar sakta/sakti hoon.

4

I'm comfortable with rotational shifts.

Mujhe rotational shifts se koi problem nahi.

5

I left my last job to grow in my career.

Maine career mein aage badhne ke liye pichli job chhodi.

6

What does a typical day look like in this role?

Is role mein ek normal din kaisa hota hai?

7

What are the next steps?

Aage ka process kya hai?

8

Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.

Aapke time ke liye shukriya. Aapke jawab ka intezaar rahega.

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

The HR roundHR round
HR

So, Imtiaz, when can you join if selected?

Toh Imtiaz, select hue toh kab join kar sakte ho?

Imtiaz

I can join within two weeks. I need to serve a short notice period.

Do hafte mein join kar sakta hoon. Thoda notice period serve karna hai.

HR

That's fine. What are your salary expectations?

Theek hai. Salary kitni expect karte ho?

Imtiaz

Based on my experience, I'm expecting around twenty-two thousand a month. But I'm open to discussion.

Mere experience ke hisaab se karib baais hazaar mahine. Par main discussion ke liye open hoon.

HR

Our budget is twenty thousand, plus incentives.

Hamara budget bees hazaar hai, plus incentives.

Imtiaz

Could you tell me more about the incentives?

Incentives ke baare mein thoda aur batayenge?

HR

Good performers usually earn three to five thousand extra.

Achha perform karne wale usually teen se paanch hazaar extra kamate hain.

Imtiaz

That sounds fair. I'm happy with that.

Ye fair lagta hai. Mujhe manzoor hai.

HR

Great. Do you have any questions for us?

Great. Aapka koi sawaal hai?

Imtiaz

Yes. What does a typical day look like in this role? And what are the next steps?

Haan. Is role mein ek normal din kaisa hota hai? Aur aage ka process kya hai?

HR

We'll explain the role in training, and you'll hear from us by Friday.

Day 28  ·  Week 4  ·  Career & Interviews

Group Discussion & Presentations

GD mein bolna aur presentation dena

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap group discussion mein confidently apni baat rakh paoge aur ek chhota presentation de paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Agar aapko 10 logon ke saamne 2 minute bolna ho, toh aapko sabse zyada darr kis cheez ka lagega?

Today's LectureAaj ki class

GD mein entry kaise lein

Pehle bolne wale ko extra points milte hain. Starters: "I'd like to start by saying...", "Building on what Ali said...", "I'd like to add a different point."

GD ke golden rules

Chillaiye mat, kisi ko cut mat kariye, doosron ka naam lekar unki baat jodiye, aur end mein summary dene ki koshish kariye: "To sum up, we all agree that..."

Presentation ka structure

Opening ("Good morning, everyone. Today I'm going to talk about...") → 3 points ("First... Second... Finally...") → Closing ("To conclude... Thank you. Any questions?")

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

I'd like to start by saying that ...

Main ye kehkar shuru karna chahunga/chahungi ki ...

2

Building on what Ali said, ...

Ali ki baat ko aage badhate hue, ...

3

I'd like to add a different point.

Main ek alag point add karna chahta/chahti hoon.

4

Let's hear from someone who hasn't spoken yet.

Chaliye unki baat sunte hain jo abhi tak nahi bole.

5

To sum up, we all agree that ...

Summary mein, hum sab maante hain ki ...

6

Good morning, everyone. Today I'm going to talk about ...

Good morning everyone. Aaj main ... ke baare mein baat karunga/karungi.

7

First ... Second ... Finally ...

Pehla ... Doosra ... Aur aakhir mein ...

8

Thank you for listening. Any questions?

Sunne ke liye shukriya. Koi sawaal?

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

GD topic: Should India have a four-day work week?GD topic: Kya India mein hafte mein 4 din kaam hona chahiye?
Moderator

The topic is: Should India have a four-day work week? You can begin.

Topic hai: Kya India mein 4-day work week hona chahiye? Shuru kariye.

Ali

I'd like to start by saying yes. People will be happier and more productive.

Main haan kehkar shuru karna chahunga. Log zyada khush aur productive honge.

Meera

Building on what Ali said, people will also have more time for family.

Ali ki baat ko aage badhate hue, logon ke paas family ke liye bhi zyada time hoga.

Owais

I'd like to add a different point. Small businesses may suffer. A shop can't close for three days.

Main ek alag point add karna chahta hoon. Chhote business ko nuksaan hoga. Dukaan teen din band nahi ho sakti.

Meera

That's a good point, Owais. Maybe it can work for offices but not for every sector.

Achha point hai Owais. Shayad offices ke liye chale, har sector ke liye nahi.

Ali

Exactly. Some companies abroad have tried it with good results.

Bilkul. Bahar kuch companies ne try kiya aur results achhe aaye.

Owais

True, but India is different. Let's hear from Sara, who hasn't spoken yet.

Sahi, par India alag hai. Sara ki baat sunte hain, jo abhi tak nahi boli.

Sara

Thanks. I think we could start with a trial in IT companies first.

Thanks. Mujhe lagta hai pehle IT companies mein trial se shuru kar sakte hain.

Meera

To sum up, we all agree it has benefits, but it should start slowly, sector by sector.

Summary mein, hum sab maante hain iske fayde hain, par dheere-dheere, sector by sector shuru hona chahiye.

Moderator

Excellent discussion. Thank you, everyone.

Bahut achha discussion. Thank you everyone.

Day 29  ·  Week 4  ·  Career & Interviews

Fluency Survival Kit

Jab atak jaao, samajh na aaye ya galti ho jaaye

Aaj ka target Aaj ke baad aap kisi bhi baatcheet mein atakne, na samajhne ya galti hone pe bina ghabraye baat sambhaal paoge.

Warm-up30 second sochiye

English bolte waqt aap kab sabse zyada atakte ho? Jab word yaad nahi aata, jab saamne wala fast bolta hai, ya jab galti ho jaati hai?

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Samajh na aaye toh

Chup rehna ya "yes yes" bolna sabse badi galti hai. Boliye: "Sorry, could you say that again?", "Could you speak a bit slower?", "What do you mean by...?"

Word yaad na aaye toh

Rukiye mat, ghuma ke boliye: "It's a thing you use to...", "What's the word... it's like a..." Fillers use kariye: "Well...", "Let me think...", "How do I put it..." Ye natural lagte hain.

Galti ho jaaye toh

Bas khud ko correct kariye aur aage badhiye: "Sorry, I mean...", "Let me say that again." Native speakers bhi roz galtiyan karte hain. Rukna nahi hai, flow banaye rakhna hai.

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

Sorry, could you say that again?

Sorry, dobara bolenge?

2

Could you speak a bit slower, please?

Thoda dheere bolenge, please?

3

What do you mean by that?

Iska aapka matlab kya hai?

4

Let me think for a second.

Ek second sochne dijiye.

5

What's the word... it's like a ...

Wo word kya hai... ye ek ... jaisa hai.

6

Sorry, I mean ...

Sorry, mera matlab hai ...

7

How do I put it ...

Kaise kahun ...

8

Did I make sense?

Meri baat samajh aayi?

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

A fast-talking customerEk tez bolne wala customer
Customer

Hi I need to change my delivery address for order four five two and also the date.

(Bahut tez) Hi mujhe order 452 ka delivery address aur date dono badalne hain.

Support

Sorry, could you speak a bit slower, please?

Sorry, thoda dheere bolenge please?

Customer

Sure, sorry. I need to change my delivery address.

Sure, sorry. Mujhe apna delivery address badalna hai.

Support

No problem. What's your order number?

Koi baat nahi. Order number kya hai?

Customer

It's four five two... sorry, I mean four five three.

Four five two... sorry, mera matlab four five three.

Support

Order 453. What's the new address?

Order 453. Naya address kya hai?

Customer

Flat 12, near the... what's the word... the big water thing on the roof?

Flat 12, wo... kya kehte hain... chhat pe wo badi paani wali cheez?

Support

Do you mean the water tank?

Aapka matlab water tank?

Customer

Yes! The water tank, Okhla Phase 2.

Haan! Water tank ke paas, Okhla Phase 2.

Support

Got it. And you said something about the date?

Mil gaya. Aur aapne date ke baare mein kuch kaha tha?

Customer

Yes, Saturday instead of Friday. Did I make sense?

Haan, Friday ki jagah Saturday. Meri baat samajh aayi?

Support

Perfectly. It's all updated. Have a great day!

Bilkul. Sab update ho gaya. Have a great day!

  2. What should the person say to fix the problem?

Hindi-wali GaltiHindi soch se hone wali galti, aur sahi tareeka

✗ Yes, yes. (when you didn't understand)

✓ Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you repeat it?

Bina samjhe "yes" bolna baad mein badi problem banata hai. Poochna smart hai.

✗ Pardon? Pardon? Pardon?

✓ Sorry, could you say that a bit more slowly?

Ek hi word baar-baar dohrane ki jagah batayiye ki kya chahiye: slower, louder, ya simpler.

✗ (Stopping completely when you forget a word)

✓ It's a thing that you use to ...

Rukna nahi! Word ko describe kariye. Saamne wala aapki help karega.

Confidence Tip

Fluency ka matlab galti na karna nahi hai. Fluency ka matlab hai galti ke baad bhi bolte rehna. Aaj se aapka mantra: "Don't stop, keep talking."

Day 30  ·  Week 4  ·  Career & Interviews

Grand Finale: Confidence Day

Grand finale: 30 din ka safar, ab aapka stage

Aaj ka target Aaj aap 30 din mein seekha sab kuch ek saath use karoge: naya introduction, kahani, opinion aur interview. Aaj aap speaker ho!

Warm-up30 second sochiye

Day 1 ka apna introduction yaad kariye. Ab wahi introduction aaj kaise doge? Kya fark aaya hai aapme?

Today's LectureAaj ki class

Aapka naya introduction (Intro 2.0)

Day 1 ka 5-step formula + Day 20 ki kahani + Day 21 ka sapna. "Hi, I'm Sana from Okhla. I'm doing B.A. and I run a small mehndi business on Instagram. A month ago, I was scared of speaking English. Today, I'm standing here talking to you. My dream is to open my own salon."

30 din ki 10 power habits jo chalti rehni chahiye

Roz 20 minute bolna, self-talk, English Hour, phone English mein, English reels, roz ek voice note, galti pe na rukna, sawaal poochna, polite lines, aur har mauke pe English bolna. Course khatam hua, practice nahi.

Aage kya?

Hafte mein ek baar class ke WhatsApp group pe 2-minute voice note bhejiye. Ek "English buddy" bana lijiye jisse roz 10 minute sirf English mein baat ho. 3 mahine mein aap khud ko pehchaan nahi paoge!

Power PhrasesYe lines aaj yaad karni hain. Speaker se suniye, mic se bolkar check kariye.

1

A month ago, I couldn't speak English in public.

Ek mahine pehle main logon ke saamne English nahi bol pata/paati tha/thi.

2

Today, I'm much more confident.

Aaj main kaafi zyada confident hoon.

3

This course changed the way I think.

Is course ne mera sochne ka tareeka badal diya.

4

I'm not afraid of making mistakes anymore.

Ab mujhe galti karne se darr nahi lagta.

5

I'd like to thank my teachers and classmates.

Main apne teachers aur classmates ka shukriya ada karna chahta/chahti hoon.

6

I promise to keep practising every day.

Main roz practice karte rehne ka waada karta/karti hoon.

7

My next goal is to ...

Mera agla goal hai ...

8

Thank you, Jamia Wallah!

Thank you, Jamia Wallah!

Real ConversationAsli baatcheet

Certificate day interview with a local reporterCertificate day pe local reporter se baat
Reporter

Congratulations! How do you feel today?

Mubarak ho! Aaj kaisa feel ho raha hai?

Ayaan

Thank you! I feel proud and a little emotional.

Shukriya! Proud feel ho raha hai aur thoda emotional bhi.

Reporter

How was your English before the course?

Course se pehle aapki English kaisi thi?

Ayaan

Honestly, I could understand a little, but I couldn't speak. I was too shy.

Sach kahun toh thoda samajh leta tha, par bol nahi paata tha. Bahut sharmata tha.

Reporter

And now?

Aur ab?

Ayaan

Now I can talk to anyone. Last week I gave a mock interview in English!

Ab main kisi se bhi baat kar sakta hoon. Pichle hafte maine English mein mock interview diya!

Reporter

What was your favourite part of the course?

Course ka sabse achha part kya tha?

Ayaan

The role-plays. We acted out real situations, like shopping and interviews.

Role-plays. Hum asli situations act karte the, jaise shopping aur interviews.

Reporter

Any advice for people who are scared to speak English?

Jo log English bolne se darte hain, unke liye koi advice?

Ayaan

Just start speaking. Mistakes are part of learning. Nobody is perfect on day one.

Bas bolna shuru kariye. Galtiyan seekhne ka hissa hain. Pehle din koi perfect nahi hota.

Reporter

Wonderful. What's next for you?

Bahut badhiya. Aage kya plan hai?

Ayaan

My next goal is to crack a bank interview. And I'll keep practising every day!

Mera agla goal bank interview crack karna hai. Aur main roz practice karta rahunga!

Final Speaking Test Day 30: aap kitne ready ho? Har "I can" pe tick lagaiye

Final task: 3-minute talk in front of the class

Neeche wala model suniye, phir apni details ke saath apna 3-minute talk banaiye: introduction, family, routine, ek yaadgaar kissa, aur aapka future plan.

Good morning, everyone. My name is Ayaan Khan and I am from Batla House, Delhi. I live with my parents and my younger sister. I am a B.Com student, and in the evenings I help my father in his shop. My day starts at six with a cup of tea. A month ago, I could not speak English in front of anyone. I was always afraid of making mistakes. In this course, I learned that mistakes are part of learning. Last week, I gave a mock interview in English, and my teacher said I was confident. In the future, I want to work in a bank and later start my own business. Thank you for listening.
